data.jd_text:
**About j. awan \& partners** 




  





 At j. awan \& partners, we believe in “challenging the status quo every day”, delivering seamless excellence to our customers across the world. We challenge the status quo by making tailor\-made solutions to meet the specific requirements of our clients’ business interests and delivering our solutions to their needs with effective simplicity. We understand that time is precious and as
 



 such our tailor\-made solutions are simple to understand, simple to embed and simple to use.
 



  





 We are a fast\-growing international Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) Consultancy with our headquarters in the Dubai International Finance Centre (DIFC). We also have our own Technology company creating bespoke cutting\-edge RegTech solutions. Our business presence covers multiple jurisdictions with offices in the UAE, KSA, UK \& Ireland, Singapore, Porto, Pakistan, Qatar and South Africa. We provide Regulatory Governance, Risk, Compliance, Finance, Recruitment and Technology services to many clients including global, regional and local financial services institutions, governments and other industry partners.
 



  





**Mission / Purpose of the Role** 




  





 The Senior Manager – Compliance role will lead and oversee regulatory compliance and AML/CTF obligations across a portfolio of client mandates within the Region. The role ensures clients are fully aligned with regulatory expectations by implementing best\-in\-class compliance frameworks, conducting ongoing monitoring, and serving as the principal regulatory liaison. Reporting to the Director of Compliance, the role drives business growth by converting existing relationships into new opportunities and supporting the expansion of the compliance practice across our operating jurisdictions. This position plays a critical role in safeguarding regulatory integrity, strengthening client trust, and elevating JAP’s compliance standards across multiple jurisdictions.
 



  





**12 – 18 Month Mission Outcomes** 




**Mission / Outcome** 




  





**Act as a trusted outsourced Compliance Officer and MLRO.** 



* Timely execution of compliance deliverables; clients’ regulatory obligations consistently met.
* Effective communication with Regulators.



  





**Deliver high\-quality Regulatory Compliance and AML services to clients.** 



* Applications submitted on schedule; licences obtained with minimal Regulator queries or rejections. Positive client feedback. No material regulatory breaches or audit findings.



  





**Develop and implement robust Compliance and AML frameworks and training programs.** 



* Policies aligned with regulatory requirements; regular AML and Compliance training conducted, resulting in improved compliance awareness among clients.



  





**Audit, monitor, and improve compliance processes.** 



* Regular compliance reviews completed; identified gaps addressed with corrective action; internal controls strengthened.



  





**Manage and expand the compliance client portfolio while supporting business growth across the Region.** 



* New business opportunities identified and supported. Strengthened client retention and satisfaction. Growth in brand visibility and market presence.



  





**Continuously improve compliance and AML/CTF systems.** 



* Implementation of new processes, tools, or automation; measurable reduction in compliance risks; adoption of industry best practices.



  





**Strengthen business development and client engagement.** 



* New client acquisitions; increased market share and revenue from compliance services; successful representation at industry events.



  





**Contribute to firm culture, brand, and people development.** 



* Positive internal and external stakeholder feedback. Support in recruitment and retention initiatives. Active mentorship and knowledge sharing within the team.



  





**Key Accountabilities** 




  





**Regulatory Compliance Delivery** 



* Provide ongoing compliance and AML support to clients.
* Draft, implement, and manage compliance and AML frameworks.
* Ensure adherence to local and international regulatory requirements.
* Compliance deliverables completed on time.
* Policies and procedures aligned with latest laws.
* No material compliance issues.



  





**Audit \& Monitoring** 



* Coordinate internal/external audits.
* Conduct compliance reviews and spot checks.
* Identify and remediate control weaknesses.
* Compliance reviews completed on schedule.
* Gaps addressed with corrective action.
* Strengthened internal controls.



  





**Training \& Awareness** 



* Deliver training on compliance, AML, and governance topics.
* Build client awareness of emerging regulations and risks.
* Client confirmation of effective and timely training delivery.
* Full client participation with positive feedback.
* Relevant regulatory updates delivered to clients.



  





**Business Development \& Brand Representation** 



* Support senior team in executing client mandates.
* Help with origination of new business.
* Represent the Firm at industry and promotional events.
* Positive feedback from senior team.
* New business opportunities identified and supported.
* Active participation in events.



  





**Leadership \& Communication** 



* Communicate compliance risks and obligations to senior management.
* Foster relationships with stakeholders, auditors, regulators, and clients.
* Represent consultancy professionally.
* Effective risk communication.
* Strong stakeholder relationships.
* Professional representation at all levels.



  





**Continuous Improvement** 



* Stay updated on regulatory developments.
* Refine compliance/AML systems, processes, and training.
* Implement best practices.
* Implementation of improved processes/tools.
* Measurable reduction in compliance risk.
* Adoption of industry best practices.



  





**Team \& Culture** 



* Promote j. awan \& partners’ culture and brand.
* Support talent attraction and retention.
* Coach and mentor junior team members.
* Positive internal engagement scores.
* Contribution to team development initiatives.
* Evidence of mentorship and knowledge sharing.



  





**Core Competencies** 



* Regulatory Expertise \& Strategic Mindset: Demonstrable experience engaging with regulatory authorities across the region, with the ability to design and implement compliance programs that mitigate risk and drive organisational effectiveness.
* Operational Excellence: Experienced in executing compliance and AML programs efficiently, ensuring high\-quality deliverables and adherence to deadlines across multiple client mandates.
* Analytical \& Problem\-Solving Skills: Exceptional capability to analyse complex regulatory issues, interpret requirements, and translate them into actionable, fit\-for\-purpose solutions.
* Integrity \& Accountability: Upholds the highest professional and ethical standards, maintains confidentiality, and demonstrates reliability and accountability in all activities.
* Stakeholder Management \& Cultural Agility: Skilled at building partnerships and influencing clients, regulators, and internal teams, with the adaptability to work effectively across diverse organisations and cultural contexts.



  





**Role\-Specific Competencies** 



* Compliance \& AML Expertise: Hands\-on experience designing, implementing, and overseeing regulatory compliance and AML frameworks within financial services, with proven ability to manage obligations across applicable regulatory regimes including but not limited to DFSA, ADGM, QFCRA, FCA, and CMA.
* KYC \& Regulatory Delivery: Proven KYC and due diligence capability including risk classification and SLA\-driven delivery, with the ability to translate evolving regulatory requirements into practical, fit\-for\-purpose policies and procedures.
* Organisation \& Execution: Strong ability to manage multiple compliance projects and competing deadlines simultaneously, working independently under pressure while maintaining accuracy and quality of delivery.
* Stakeholder \& Communication Skills: Exceptional oral and written communication skills for effective interaction with clients, regulators, and senior leadership, with strong interpersonal skills to build and maintain productive working relationships.



  





**Education** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Economics, or Accountancy.



  





**Experience** 



* Significant demonstrable experience in dealing with regulatory authorities within the Region.
* Minimum 8 years overall industry experience, with at least 4 years in Compliance roles within Financial Services.
* Direct experience in developing and implementing compliance programs is essential.
* Direct experience in creating and implementing regulatory compliance programs within a successful financial services organisation.



  





**Additional Requirements** 



* CAMS, CISI, or ICA qualifications preferred.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; additional languages are a plus.

 **Head of Marketing** 
 for our
 **Mobility \& Logistics portfolio** 
 , where you’ll lead strategic, insight\-driven marketing initiatives that drive growth, enhance audience engagement, and strengthen the positioning of our events across the region.

* Minimum 6\+ years’ experience in marketing, ideally within the exhibitions or events industry
* Proven experience in developing and delivering integrated, data\-driven marketing strategies across multiple channels
* Strong leadership experience with a track record of building and developing high\-performing teams
* Excellent stakeholder management skills, with experience working across senior leadership and external partners
* Strong understanding of data, segmentation, persona development, and marketing automation tools
* Experience managing agencies and delivering high\-quality, impactful campaigns
* Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to influence and engage diverse audiences

The company operates from its headquarters in Riyadh, with additional regional and global support offices.
   

  

**Your Role**
 This role requires you to be a Swiss Army knife. It'll engage every skill you have and make your brain cells perk up—left brain, right brain, and muscles you didn't know you had.
   

  

 If you're the type who enjoys building the plane while it's flying, this is your seat. We're a brand\-new comms department, inside a 1,000\-person scale\-up operating across multiple offices and time zones.
   

  

 There's structure where it matters and space to build it where it doesn't exist yet.You'll help shape how we work, not just execute what's already there.
   

  

 We're in charge of crafting the company's narrative and ensuring it's clear, consistent, and visible across all our stakeholders: customers, partners, media, talent, investors, regulators, and more.We're looking for a PMO Specialist to help run, coordinate, and deliver the work that keeps our Communications function moving forward.

**About The Role**
 The PMO Manager is responsible for overseeing and optimizing project management activities across multiple streams to ensure the successful delivery of projects. This role involves supporting Project Managers (PMs), managing knowledge bases, ensuring the execution of Hypercare activities, and identifying and resolving risks and dependencies. The PMO Manager plays a key role in promoting cross\-stream alignment, implementing communication and escalation plans, and providing guidance to the project management team to achieve organizational goals.
   

  

**As a part of your job, you will:**
* Knowledge Management: Responsible for maintaining and organizing the project knowledge base, ensuring that all relevant project documentation is up to date and accessible.
* Support PMs in KPIs: Assist Project Managers in updating and tracking Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to ensure projects are aligned with organizational goals and performance metrics.
* Hypercare Activities: Lead and manage Hypercare activities, ensuring that projects transition smoothly from development to production and all post\-launch issues are addressed in a timely manner.
* Risk \& Issue Management: Collaborate with PMs to identify, assess, and resolve project risks, issues, and dependencies, ensuring projects remain on track and within scope.
* Promote Cross\-Stream Alignment: Foster strong communication and alignment between different project streams and teams, ensuring efficient collaboration and minimizing conflicts or misunderstandings.
* Communication \& Escalation Plans: Design, implement, and manage comprehensive communication and escalation plans to ensure timely updates and issue resolution across all levels of the project.
* Escalation to PMO Director: Escalate any critical project risks, issues, or delays to the PMO Director, providing them with necessary insights and support to make informed decisions.
* Coaching \& Mentoring: Provide guidance and mentorship to Project Managers, helping to build their skills and ensure adherence to best practices and processes.
* Vendor Management: Manage relationships with external vendors, ensuring they meet project requirements, timelines, and quality standards. Collaborate with vendors to address any performance issues and ensure smooth project delivery.


**What are we looking for?**
**Education:**

**Innovation Program Manager (Full\-time, Part\-time or Consultation)** 




  





**About Setup.sa:**




 Setup.sa is a Saudi Consulting firm specializing in softlanding and market entry solutions for international companies. We pride ourselves in being a knowledge house, driven by technology.
 



 Setup.sa was able to leave a mark and build its name in the competitive Saudi market in an exceptionally short time. We are currently one of the fastest growing firms in Saudi Arabia, doubling our number of clients on a monthly basis.
 



  





 As we scale, we still strive to offer operational excellence while changing the way softlanding is done in KSA and raising the bar for the standards of service provision in our sector, pushing the expectations of the clients and the market higher.
 



  





 Being a consulting house, we exist to ensure that the process and journey for foreign companies’ incorporation and operations is done in the easiest and most cost\-efficient way possible.
 



 As this is our North Star, we could build the highest\-value solution in the market and subsequently serve some of the top companies and renowned startups around the world along with multiple government programs. We keep our promises to exceed our clients’ expectations by always going the extra mile, even if the client doesn’t get to know about it.
 



  





 The people working with us expect a lot from themselves and are interested in building solutions that change the way the industry works. They have strong ambitions to achieve exceptional success personally and professionally.
 



  





 Our team is performance\-driven and serious. And we would like to invite you to work with us and become a part of a growing company that has a credible brand name and enjoy an exceptional learning journey.
 



  





**Job Title:**




 Innovation Program Manager
 



  





**Seniority Level:**




 Mid\-senior Level
 



  





**Job Type:**




 Full\-time, Part\-time or Consultation
 



  





**Job Location:**




 Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
 



  





**Role Overview:**




  





 The Innovation Program Manager leads the design and execution of incubation, acceleration and venture building programs in Setup.sa, guiding startups across the full journey from idea validation to go\-to\-market. The role focuses on building and managing the entrepreneurship ecosystem by connecting founders with mentors, partners, and investors. It also ensures the successful delivery, growth, and impact of innovation programs aligned with strategic objectives.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:**




  




1. Design, develop, and continuously improve incubation, acceleration and venture building programs covering the full innovation lifecycle from idea validation to go\-to\-market.
2. Identify and attract high\-potential startups and entrepreneurs locally and internationally.
3. Guide startups through key stages including problem validation, solution design, MVP (Minimum Viable Product) development, product\-market fit, and scaling.
4. Oversee the progress of startups within the program, and support founders in developing clear business models, value propositions, and go\-to\-market strategies.
5. Attract and manage relationships with investors, venture capital firms, angel networks, and funding entities.
6. Facilitate investor readiness for startups through pitch coaching, financial modeling guidance, and preparation of investment materials, while organizing demo days, investor meetings, and networking events to connect startups with funding opportunities.
7. Build strategic partnerships with corporates, government entities, and ecosystem players to support program objectives.
8. Establish a strong network of mentors, advisors, and industry experts, ensuring relevant and high\-quality support for startups.
9. Monitor market trends, emerging technologies, and innovation practices to continuously enhance the program.
10. Manage program operations including planning, budgeting, resource allocation, and reporting.



  





**Required Qualifications:**




  




* Experience of 8\+ years in innovation management, entrepreneurship and startup ecosystems
* Proven experience in designing and managing incubation, acceleration and venture building programs
* Strong hands\-on experience across the full startup lifecycle from idea stage to scaling and go\-to\-market
* Deep understanding of the Saudi market and its entrepreneurship and innovation ecosystem.
* Experience in attracting and managing funding partners, investors, or venture capital relationships
* Solid experience in stakeholder management across founders, investors, mentors, corporates, and government entities
* Strong understanding of emerging technologies and innovation trends (e.g., AI, fintech, sustainability), along with proficiency in using work management tools (e.g., Notion, Asana)
* Bachelor’s degree
* Preferred: master’s degree (MBA or equivalent)
* Fluent in both Arabic and English

data.jd_text:
**About Lucidya**
 Lucidya is an AI\-native platform for customer experience (CX) intelligence that manages entire customer lifecycles autonomously, from initial engagement through retention and growth.
   

  

 Unlike platforms that only surface insights and leave the action to you, Lucidya completes the loop with proprietary NLU capabilities developed entirely in\-house and trained on millions of multilingual conversations, equipping marketing, support, CX, and research teams to deliver personalised experiences that drive measurable improvements in customer satisfaction, retention, and lifetime value.
   

  

**Why This Role Matters**
 Enterprise clients don't churn because of the product. They churn because implementation fails, adoption stalls, or they never get to the outcome they were sold.
   

  

 As Lucidya moves upmarket \- BFSI, telecom, media, retail \- the complexity of deployments grows. Onboarding a large enterprise is no longer a handoff. It's a multi\-month, multi\-stakeholder programme with real financial and reputational stakes on both sides.
   

  

 This role owns that entire delivery motion. You will build and lead the team responsible for getting customers from signed contracts to measurable value \- and keeping them there. You will own the managed services P\&L and the operational rigour that separates a world\-class implementation function from a reactive project management team.
   

  

 If you are energised by building structure in complexity, are equally comfortable in a client boardroom and a resource planning spreadsheet, and want your work to directly determine whether enterprise customers succeed \- this role is built for you.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
**Lead delivery end\-to\-end.**
* Execute the PMO strategy across customer onboarding, implementation, migration, and ongoing managed services \- translating strategic direction into reliable, repeatable delivery
* Ensure every project is delivered within scope, on time, and within budget \- and that CSAT and NPS reflect it
* Serve as the executive escalation point when projects hit risk. You do not wait to be told \- you see it coming
* Develop, enforce, and continuously improve standardised delivery methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, or Hybrid depending on the engagement)


**Own the commercial side of services.**
* Own the deal economics for managed services \- project profitability, gross margins, and commercial accountability for the delivery function
* Forecast team capacity, manage utilisation, and optimise staffing across implementation specialists, project managers, analysts, and designers to match pipeline demand
* Work with Sales to scope SOWs accurately. Overpromising at the deal stage is a delivery problem \- you have a say in preventing it


**Build and develop the team.**
* Lead a team of Project Managers, Implementation Specialists, and Programme Managers
* Mentor the team on advanced client management, negotiation, risk mitigation, and how to balance client customisation requests against platform scalability
* Build a culture of product stewardship \- the team should be Lucidya's strongest advocates for what the platform does well, not just executors of client requests


**Be the bridge between clients and the business.**
* Manage expectations on custom development by bridging communication between clients and Engineering and Product teams \- clearly, without overpromising
* Report project health, velocity, and risk to executive leadership in a way that enables fast decisions
* Partner with clients on internal capability building \- recruitment of client\-side resources, upskilling programmes, and adoption ramp plans that increase their self\-sufficiency over time
* Drive continuous improvement. Every delivery cycle should produce lessons that shorten the next one


 You are responsible for outcomes: delivery quality, margin, client satisfaction, and a team that gets better every quarter.
   

  

**Who You Are**
* You have 7\-10\+ years of professional experience, with at least 3\-5 years leading project or delivery teams inside a SaaS environment
* You have run complex, multi\-stakeholder enterprise implementations \- and you have the scars to prove it
* You are as comfortable in a C\-suite escalation conversation as you are in a weekly project status call. You know how to communicate risk without creating panic
* You understand the commercial side of services. Margin, utilisation rates, and SOW scope are not someone else's problem
* You do not manage by spreadsheet alone. You understand what motivates delivery teams and how to build a culture that takes ownership of client outcomes
* You have a working knowledge of SaaS architecture, APIs, and cloud\-based implementations \- enough to have credible technical conversations with clients and product teams
* You hold or have held a PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile/Scrum certification. You apply methodology pragmatically, not dogmatically
* You are comfortable in a fast\-scaling environment where process is still being built. You improve the system while running it


**Culturally, you are:**
* Structured but adaptable
* Client\-obsessed but commercially grounded
* A builder, not just a manager
* Calm under pressure \- and you set that tone for your team


**What The Hiring Process Will Look Like**
* Screening call with Talent Acquisition
* Deep\-dive interview with the CRO
* Case study presentation \- delivery scenario and P\&L walk\-through
* Offer

**Responsibilities?**
 We are recruiting experienced Telecoms Engineer, capable of lead \& supervise, Installation, Test and Commissioning of telecom systems for following disciplines for railway system;
   

  

* TCP/IP, IP\-MPLS,
* CCTV
* Video Management System

* Coordinate with other entities (other ALSTOM activities/ civil work partners…) for the technical aspects of the interfaces and especially with the civil works.

* Support and coordinate the Telecom activities on site

* Ensure support on normative aspects
* Ensure design review application according to projects milestones

 In this role, you serves as the Project Company’s senior technical engineer and advisors for and in respect of all related work, services, tasks, activities and actions related to the Telecommunications Systems.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Communication Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or equivalent.
* Knowledge of network infrastructure (switches/routers/firewall/media convertor/etc,)
* Knowledge of associated protocols (TCP/IP, MPLS,LAN\-WAN), routing principles (static\&dynamic).
* CCNA \& CCNP certification is a plus
* Telecom Engineer, specialized with minimum 10 years\-experience in telecom subsystems and interfaces (experience railway systems is a plus).
* Good Communications and interpersonal skills including with third parties (client).
* Structured and organized with Hands\-on approach
* Extensive working knowledge of Complex Networks design, both wired and wireless
* Extensive experience with network architecture design
* Working knowledge of Switching and Routing protocols
* Working knowledge of wireless communications in demanding scenarios
* Prior experience managing medium\-large sized projects and project teams
* Working knowledge of Test and commissioning processes
* Detail oriented with organizational skills
* Fluency in English, both written and spoken.
* Experience in the railway Signalling Systems sector would be a plus.


 You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!
   

  

**Important to note**
 As a global business, we’re an equal\-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

**Job Description**
 We are seeking a highly qualified and experienced Senior Project Manager with a strong technical background in infrastructure and/or master planning to lead and oversee complex Land Development projects within our organisation. The role will have a focus on KSA projects, either based in KSA or in UAE with a requirement for periodic travel to KSA to meet project requirements.
   

  

 The successful candidate will have extensive project management experience as well as a strong technical understanding in Land Development disciplines (master planning, infrastructure, transport planning, landscaping, sustainability). The ideal candidate will possess Middle East experience with the knowledge, skills and expertise to lead multi\-disciplinary land development teams and drive internationally significant Land development projects from inception to completion.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Project Leadership – Lead and manage Land Development Projects (Master Planning, Transport Planning, Roads, Utilities, Landscape), ensuring alignment with Client objectives and regulatory requirements
* Team Management – Build and lead cross\-functional project teams, providing guidance, mentorship and motivation to team members to achieve project goals
* Client Interaction – Cultivate and maintain strong client relationships, understand their needs and ensure project deliverables meet or exceed client expectations whilst aligning with project budgets
* Cost and Resource Management \- Develop project budgets, monitor and control expenditures, and allocate resources efficiently to optimise project outcomes
* Risk Management \- Identify potential project risks and develop mitigation strategies to ensure project success
* Scope and Schedule Management \- Develop a work breakdown structure for the project, create schedules, monitor and control project progress against schedule. Ensure scope and deliverables are well defined. Ensure variance and scope creep are identified and that change is adequately documented and managed
* Quality Management \- Manage and control quality on the project by implementing WSP processes and templates and instilling and maintaining a quality culture across the project.
* Procurement Management \- Apply commercial and legal acumen (with the contributions of support functions) to manage procurement activities on the project, ensuring Main Agreement Execution, Change Control and supplier / subcontractor appointments,
* Stakeholder and Communication Management \- Establish stakeholder and communication management plans. Ensure communication is efficiently and accurately flowing into and out of the project, in accordance with business protocols. Evaluate stakeholder power and influence and ensure relevant feedback is considered and requisite approvals sought


**Qualifications**
* Proven project management experience on large and complex Land Development projects in the Middle East
* Minimum 10 years of experience in Land Development discipline (e.g. Civil Engineering, Utilities, Roads, Transport Planning, Master Planning)
* Degree in Land Development discipline (e.g. Civil Engineering, Utilities, Roads, Transport Planning, Master Planning)


**Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.**
 Work on landmark projects around the world and embrace opportunities to make an even bigger impact in the communities you care about. What if you could do the best work of your life and create a legacy for yourself?

**Overview**
 AtkinsRéalis is looking for a Senior Project Controls Manager, in Saudi Arabia
   

  

 The Senior Project Controls Manager, must have a minimum of 15 years' management experience, ensure that the project management function operates efficiently across the Consultant's'organization and with external stakeholders. The successful candidate will be responsible for developing and implementing a comprehensive Service Delivery Plan covering all activities, including schedule performance and deviation tracking. The successful candidate will review and manage each O\&M Contractor's'operation and maintenance schedules against the Employer's requirements and objectives, ensuring that each contractor and third party achieves agreed performance targets and key milestones. The Senior Project Controls Manager will also be responsible for developing and enforcing scheduling, document control, and reporting procedures, ensuring full compliance with contractual and operational standards.
   

  

**Your role**
**Project Controls Oversight**
* Develop and maintain a Service Delivery Plan for all project control activities.
* Monitor schedule performance and identify deviations across all project phases.
* Ensure efficient project management practices within the Consultant's'organization and with external interfaces.


**Schedule Management**
* Review and manage O\&M Contractors' operation and maintenance schedules.
* Ensure alignment with the Employer's'objectives and contractual milestones.
* Track progress and performance against key deliverables.


**Compliance \& Procedures**
* Develop and maintain Risk Management practices and reporting dashboards.
* Develop and implement scheduling, document control, and reporting procedures


**About You**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Project Management, or a related field (Master's preferred).
* Minimum 15 years of management experience in project controls, preferably in the rail or metro sector.
* Proven expertise in schedule management, document control, and performance tracking.
* Strong leadership, organizational, and communication skills.
* Ability to manage complex multi\-stakeholder environments.
* Familiarity with project control tools and methodologies.

**This Includes**

* Relocation assistance.
* Transportation \& housing allowances (available for remote work locations).

 Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

You will serve as Joby’s local face, elevating brand awareness, representing the company with stakeholders and media, translating market insights into action, and providing clear performance updates to executive leadership and the board.

* PMO \& Project Controls Capability: Able to undertake all aspects of PMO support, including reporting, governance, programme coordination, document control, action tracking, and maintaining project controls.
* Financial Management \& Forecasting: Competent in managing project financials, including monitoring time charged, tracking spend, reviewing budgets, and maintaining accurate cost forecasts.
* Resilience \& Commitment: Comfortable working in demanding, fast\-paced environments, including longer days or additional hours when required to meet project milestones and business needs.
* Adaptability \& Flexibility: Responds positively to changing priorities, urgent issues, and evolving project requirements while maintaining a high standard of delivery.
* Communication: Exceptional command of written and spoken English. Ability to present complex data in a visually compelling and concise manner. Arabic proficiency is desirable.

* Certification: Active PMP (Project Management Professional) or Chartered Planner (RTPI/AICP/MRICS) status is highly desirable.

data.jd_text:
Since 2004, 2P has been a leader in Saudi Arabia’s ICT landscape, delivering integrated technology solutions that help organizations accelerate digital transformation and improve operational efficiency. With a strong foundation in innovation and service excellence, 2P continues to provide end\-to\-end solutions through its specialized business units and trusted market expertise. We are always looking to connect with talented professionals who are passionate about making an impact and growing within a dynamic, forward\-looking environment.
 



  





 We are seeking a strategic and technical Program Manager to oversee the Operations and Maintenance (O\&M) of enterprise IT infrastructure. This role is responsible for ensuring the successful delivery of ICT deployment projects, while maintaining the security, availability, and scalability of clients’ data centers, cloud environments, and network systems.
 



  





 This role bridges high\-level business strategy with day\-to\-day technical execution, ensuring that clients’ always\-on environments meet stringent Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




 • Lead the long\-term roadmap for infrastructure stability, lifecycle management, and hardware/software refreshes.
 



 • Oversee Operations and Maintenance (O\&M) activities for enterprise IT infrastructure.
 



 • Ensure the successful delivery of ICT deployment projects across data centers, cloud environments, and network systems.
 



 • Act as the escalation point for major outages and critical incidents.
 



 • Drive Root Cause Analysis (RCA) to prevent recurrence of incidents and improve service reliability.
 



 • Manage OPEX and CAPEX budgets, vendor contracts, and resource allocation.
 



 • Ensure high availability, disaster recovery readiness, and SLA compliance.
 



 • Oversee infrastructure lifecycle management from procurement and deployment to decommissioning and recycling.
 



 • Manage third\-party service providers, MSPs, and hardware vendors to ensure service quality and accountability.
 



 • Use data\-driven insights to support capacity planning and forecast future infrastructure needs.
 



 • Ensure infrastructure compliance with industry\-specific and client standards.
 



 • Lead operational improvements using monitoring tools, KPIs, MTTR, and uptime metrics.
 



 • Build a culture of continuous learning, accountability, and operational excellence within the team.
 



 • Apply Agile or Kanban frameworks to ICT projects to improve delivery velocity.
 



  





**Required Competencies:** 




 • Strong knowledge of ITIL framework and IT Service Management, including Incident, Change, Problem, and Request Fulfillment.
 



 • Solid experience in infrastructure lifecycle management.
 



 • Strong expertise in High Availability and Disaster Recovery (DR).
 



 • Experience in designing and maintaining zero\-downtime architectures and conducting regular DR drills.
 



 • Financial literacy in budget tracking, forecasting, and infrastructure investment justification.
 



 • Strong vendor and SLA management experience.
 



 • Ability to negotiate with and manage third\-party service providers and hardware vendors.
 



 • Strong capacity planning skills using data\-driven insights.
 



 • Experience in compliance, auditing, and infrastructure governance.
 



 • Strong stakeholder communication skills with the ability to translate technical issues into business language.
 



 • Strong risk management and mitigation planning skills.
 



 • Strong change management strategy experience to maintain architectural stability without slowing cross\-functional delivery.
 



 • Strong data\-driven decision\-making skills.
 



 • Strong team leadership and mentorship capabilities.
 



 • Experience in Agile or Kanban methodologies.
 



  





**Qualifications \& Requirements:** 




 • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, MIS, or a related field.
 



 • 8\+ years of experience in IT infrastructure, ICT operations, data center operations, or related fields.
 



 • 3–5 years of experience in program management, infrastructure leadership, or senior technical management.
 



 • Strong experience in data centers, cloud environments, network systems, security operations, disaster recovery, and IT service management.
 



 • Experience managing cross\-functional technical teams, vendors, budgets, SLAs, and enterprise\-level infrastructure programs.
 



 • PMP, PgMP, ITIL, Agile/Scrum, AWS, Azure, or GCP certifications are preferred.
 



 • Strong English communication skills.
 



 • Arabic communication skills are preferred for client and stakeholder engagement in Saudi Arabia.

data.jd_text:
**Alomar Holding Company** 
 is a leading Saudi\-based diversified holding group specializing in real estate development and property management. As part of our ongoing growth in Riyadh, we are seeking a Site Project Manager to oversee the execution of residential construction projects, ensuring delivery to the highest standards.
   

  

 This role is pivotal in managing all aspects of site operations, from early construction phases through handover and closeout. You will lead multidisciplinary teams, coordinate with stakeholders, and ensure projects are completed safely, efficiently, and within budget.
   

  

 Key responsibilities include:
   

  

* Managing daily on\-site execution of residential construction projects from initiation to final delivery and closeout
* Leading and supervising site teams, subcontractors, suppliers, and labor to ensure smooth operations
* Coordinating civil, structural, architectural, finishing, fit\-out, and MEP interface activities
* Collaborating with consultants and client representatives, overseeing inspections, approvals, RFIs, NCRs, and site instructions
* Controlling progress, quality, safety, procurement, and documentation to meet approved specifications, budget, and schedule
* Reviewing and managing drawings, specifications, BOQs, schedules, method statements, material submittals, and inspection requests
* Preparing progress reports, lookahead schedules, site updates, and management reports; identifying delays and implementing recovery plans
* Supporting payment applications, quantity verification, variation orders, and claims in coordination with QS/cost control teams
* Leading snagging/de\-snagging, testing/commissioning coordination, handover documentation, and closeout processes


**Requirements**
**Required Qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering
* 8\+ years of construction/project management experience, including at least 3 years in a site leadership role such as Project Manager or Site Project Manager
* Extensive contractor\-side residential construction experience managing projects from early construction through handover (villas, townhouses, apartments, compounds)
* On\-site execution experience across civil, structural, architectural, and finishing/fit\-out works on residential projects
* Strong proficiency with Primavera P6 and/or MS Project
* Experience managing construction execution using project schedules, lookahead planning, quality control procedures, inspection workflows, subcontractor coordination, and handover processes
* Experience coordinating MEP interface activities with MEP teams/subcontractors and collaborating with consultants and developer/client representatives for inspections, approvals, RFIs, NCRs, and site instructions
* Ability to work full\-time on construction sites, conduct regular site inspections, and participate in progress walks and coordination meetings
* Saudi Council of Engineers registration (or eligibility to register/transfer classification)
* Professional/business English proficiency
* Eligibility to work in Saudi Arabia


**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Working proficiency with AutoCAD
* PMP certification
* Experience producing progress reports, lookahead plans, tracking delays, and implementing recovery actions on construction projects
* Experience in the Riyadh or Saudi market
* Ability to start within 30 days (notice period ≤30 days)


**Benefits**
* Health insurance coverage (medical, dental, vision)
* Paid annual leave and public holidays
* On\-site support and resources for project management
* Opportunities for advancement within a leading Saudi investment group

Qiddiya is Saudi Arabia's future capital of entertainment, sports, and culture — a 360 km² mega\-project just outside Riyadh. From F1\-grade racetracks and theme parks to stadiums and performance venues, we're creating a destination like no other. This is more than a project — it's a national transformation. As construction accelerates, we're hiring ambitious talent to help shape it. If you're driven by scale, impact, and the chance to build something iconic from the ground up — Qiddiya is calling
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 Lead the planning and execution of all event operations and site\-wide delivery at Cultural and Heritage program, ensuring safe, efficient, and high\-quality delivery of cultural programming, guest experience, and large\-scale event operations in alignment with asset objectives
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Event Operations Planning \& Delivery**
* Lead end\-to\-end planning and execution of all event operations across Cultural and Heritage program, including the Festival and year\-round programming
* Translate programming, marketing, and commercial plans into detailed operational delivery models
* Develop and manage event operations plans, schedules, and resource requirements
* Ensure seamless execution of all programming and activities in line with operational plans


**Logistics, Site Readiness \& Overlay**
* Lead planning and execution of logistics, site readiness, and event overlay (temporary infrastructure, structures, utilities, and services)
* Ensure readiness of all operational infrastructure prior to opening and across event cycles
* Oversee site setup, dismantling, and transition between events or programming phases
* Coordinate movement planning including access, transport, parking, and crowd flows


**Health, Safety \& Security (HSE)**
* Establish and enforce HSE and security frameworks across all operations
* Oversee crowd management planning, emergency response, and incident management protocols
* Ensure compliance with regulatory and authority requirements
* Coordinate with security agencies and government entities to ensure safe delivery


**Guest Experience \& On\-Ground Delivery**
* Ensure delivery of a high\-quality, safe, and seamless visitor experience across all touchpoints
* Oversee guest flow, queue management, accessibility, and service standards
* Monitor on\-ground performance and address operational issues in real time


**Vendor \& Operator Management**
* Oversee management of all operational vendors, contractors, and service providers
* Ensure vendor performance meets operational, safety, and service standards
* Coordinate with procurement and contract management functions


**Cross\-Functional Integration \& Feasibility**
* Lead operational feasibility assessment of programming, commercial, and marketing initiatives
* Ensure alignment between programming requirements and operational capabilities
* Work closely with:
+ Programming → feasibility and scheduling
+ Commercial → activation requirements
+ Marketing → campaign\-driven demand


**Asset \& Site Coordination**
* Coordinate closely with Asset \& Site Management on facilities, maintenance, and infrastructure readiness
* Ensure operational alignment with permanent and temporary asset requirements
* Support long\-term planning of site usage and capacity


**Asset Management \& Group Alignment**
* Align operational plans with Asset Management direction and performance expectations
* Coordinate with Qiddiya Group functions and external authorities where required
* Provide operational input into planning, budgeting, and performance reviews


**Performance Monitoring \& Continuous Improvement**
* Define and track operational KPIs including service levels, efficiency, and safety
* Monitor performance during events and identify improvement opportunities
* Implement continuous improvement initiatives across operations


**Key Success Metrics**
* Operational delivery against plan
* Visitor experience and satisfaction
* Health, safety, and security performance
* Efficiency of event execution
* Readiness and delivery of major events


**Required Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong experience in large\-scale event operations and delivery
* Ability to manage complex logistics and site operations
* Strong knowledge of crowd management and HSE standards
* Ability to operate in high\-pressure, fast\-paced environments
* Cross\-functional coordination and execution capability


**Requirements**
* 12\-15\+ years of experience, with a significant portion in leadership roles overseeing large\-scale operations and event delivery
* Proven experience in:
* Planning and delivering large\-scale events, festivals, or destination operations with high visitor volumes
* Managing complex, multi\-site or multi\-zone environments involving diverse activities and stakeholders
* Leading end\-to\-end event operations, including planning, logistics, site readiness, and live delivery
* Strong experience in:
* Crowd management, HSE, and security operations within large public events
* Operational planning and logistics, including transport, access, and site movement
* Vendor and contractor management across multiple service lines
* Demonstrated ability to:
* Operate in high\-pressure, real\-time environments with critical decision\-making responsibilities
* Manage and coordinate with government authorities, regulatory bodies, and security agencies
* Lead large, cross\-functional operational teams and on\-ground workforce
* Experience in:
* Pre\-opening and activation phases of large\-scale venues, events, or destinations (preferred)
* Transitioning from readiness to live operations and managing ongoing operational cycles

**Job Summary**
 The Project Director is responsible for the overall leadership and delivery of large\-scale data centre projects in Saudi Arabia within a general contracting environment. The role has full accountability for project performance, including safety, programme, cost, quality, and commercial outcomes, ensuring compliance with Saudi regulations, local authority requirements, and contractual obligations. Working closely with clients, consultants, subcontractors and key stakeholders, the Project Director builds, develops and leads multidisciplinary teams to deliver mission\-critical data centre facilities to the highest standards, while managing local supply chains, Saudization requirements, and fast\-track project demands in the KSA market.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Project Leadership \& Delivery:**
* Provide end\-to\-end leadership for complex, mission\-critical data centre project from mobilisation through commissioning and handover.
* Take full responsibility for project performance, including programme, cost control, quality, safety, and risk management.
* Ensure compliance with contractual requirements, technical specifications, and regional regulations.
* Lead project governance, reporting, and decision\-making at senior and client levels.
* Appointment of individuals to key project positions.
* Work across company functional departments to engage support for on time delivery.


**Client \& Stakeholder Management:**
* Act as the primary senior point of contact for clients, consultants, subcontractors and key stakeholders.
* Build and maintain strong client relationships, ensuring confidence in delivery and responsiveness.
* Manage client expectations and lead negotiations on variations, claims, and commercial matters.


**Commercial \& Contractual Oversight:**
* Oversee commercial strategy in collaboration with commercial team.
* Ensure effective cost control, forecasting, and cash flow management.
* Review and approve major subcontract packages, procurement strategies, and commercial decisions.
* Manage risk, claims, and dispute avoidance/resolution.


**Team \& Resource Management:**
* Build, Lead, mentor, and develop project management, engineering, construction, and support teams.
* Ensure appropriate resourcing, capability, and succession planning for project delivery.
* Promote a strong culture of safety, accountability, and performance excellence.


**Programme, Quality \& Safety:**
* Ensure robust planning and programme controls are in place to meet critical data centre milestones.
* Drive best\-in\-class quality assurance and control processes aligned with data centre standards.
* Champion health, safety, and environmental excellence across all project activities.


**Pre\-Construction \& Business Support:**
* Support pre\-construction, tendering, and bid teams with construction methodology, programme input, and risk reviews.
* Contribute to value engineering, buildability reviews, and logistics planning.
* Support business development efforts related to data centre opportunities where required.


**Preferred Experience \& Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline.
* 15\+ years’ experience in construction delivery, with significant experience as a Project Director or Senior Project Manager.
* Proven track record delivering large\-scale data centre projects within a General Contracting / Main Contractor environment.
* Middle East \& Saudi Arabia experience, including knowledge of local regulations and practices.
* Demonstrated experience managing large, multi\-disciplinary teams and major subcontractors.
* Strong commercial, contractual, and risk management expertise.


**Key Competencies**
* Executive\-level project leadership
* Data centre construction expertise (mission\-critical environments)
* Client and stakeholder management
* Commercial and contractual acumen
* Programme and risk management
* Decision\-making under pressure
* Safety and quality leadership


**Personal Attributes**
* Strong leadership presence and credibility at client and executive level.
* Highly organised, decisive, and results\-driven.
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage multi\-cultural teams.
* Ability to operate effectively in fast\-paced, high\-risk, mission\-critical environments.

data.jd_text:
The Director \- Operations \& Maintenance is responsible for leading the operational management and maintenance of city assets and public realm infrastructure, ensuring all assets are safe, efficient, compliant, and operationally ready to support the wider development objectives.
   

  

 The role will oversee the delivery of both hard and soft services through a combination of in\-house teams and outsourced service providers, ensuring high standards of operational performance, customer service, asset reliability, and stakeholder satisfaction across the portfolio.
   

  

 The Director will lead a team of up to 10 professionals and will be responsible for managing contractor performance across multiple disciplines including public realm maintenance, electrical infrastructure, utilities, and wastewater treatment plant operations. The role will also ensure assets are successfully transitioned from construction into operations through structured handover, snagging, defect management, and operational readiness processes.
   

  

 Working closely with internal and external stakeholders, the Director will drive operational excellence, governance compliance, health \& safety standards, budget control, and continuous improvement initiatives across all operations and maintenance activities.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Lead and manage all operations and maintenance activities across city assets and public realm infrastructure.
* Manage and develop a team of up to 10 staff, including performance management, team development, and annual reviews.
* Oversee third\-party contractors delivering hard and soft FM services, ensuring performance aligns with KPIs, SLAs, and operational standards.
* Supervise the operational oversight of critical infrastructure through the delivery teams, including wastewater treatment plants, electrical infrastructure, utilities, and associated systems.
* Drive high levels of customer service and user experience across all delivery partners and operational activities.
* Manage operational and maintenance budgets, cost controls, forecasting, and financial reporting.
* Lead stakeholder engagement with internal departments, authorities, consultants, service providers, and external partners.
* Support design and technical reviews to ensure maintainability, operational efficiency, and lifecycle considerations are embedded within assets.
* Lead asset handover and operational readiness activities including inspections, snagging, defect resolution, commissioning support, and transition into operations.
* Ensure compliance with governance frameworks, regulatory requirements, and health, safety, and environmental standards.
* Identify operational risks, troubleshoot issues, and implement effective problem\-solving and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Develop and implement operational procedures, maintenance strategies, and performance standards to optimize asset reliability and efficiency.


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Facilities Management, Operations Management, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 15 years of experience in operations and maintenance management across large\-scale city assets, infrastructure, public realm, or mixed\-use developments.
* Proven experience managing hard and soft services contractors within complex operational environments.
* Strong understanding of infrastructure operations including utilities, electrical systems, and wastewater treatment operations.
* Demonstrated leadership experience managing multidisciplinary teams and service providers.
* Strong knowledge of operational governance, health \& safety, compliance, and risk management practices.
* Experience managing operational budgets, contract performance, and service delivery KPIs.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience supporting asset operational readiness, handover, snagging, and transition from construction to operations.
* Ability to drive operational excellence, customer service standards, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Experience within the Middle East region is preferred

**Role Summary**
 The Program Director provides executive\-level leadership and strategic oversight across all LDIP PMCM phases. As the primary point of accountability, the incumbent ensures that all PMCM services are delivered to the highest professional standards, on time, and in full compliance with the requirements, contractual obligations, and applicable national and international standards.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Strategic Leadership \& Program Governance
* Serve as the ultimate professional authority and single point of accountability for PMCM delivery across all phases and sites
* Define and implement the Program Execution Strategy, governance framework, and management methodology; provide executive decision\-making on all scope, schedule, cost, quality, and risk matters
* Direct the PMCM team across all disciplines — program management, design, controls, commercial, QHSE, risk, and document control — ensuring consistent performance and alignment
* Design Management \& Procurement (Phase A \& B)
* Oversee PMCM design management across DMP and pre\-construction phases, ensuring Lead Developer outputs comply with LDIP design intent, program objectives, target zoning, plot ratios, and standards
* Direct Value Engineering sessions, procurement strategy development, and tendering processes in compliance with Ministry of Finance regulations
* Construction Supervision \& Contract Administration (Phase C)
* Lead management and supervision of Lead Developer entities across all sites through construction, enforcing compliance with the Terms of Engagement, schedules, regulatory requirements, and quality standards
* Oversee contract administration including payment certification, change order management, claims evaluation, and stakeholder interface coordination with government authorities and utility providers
* Project Controls \& Reporting
* Establish and maintain the Project Controls framework covering schedule, cost, quality, and risk; ensure EVM, KPI tracking, and risk mitigation are implemented consistently across the program
* 
* Review and approve all major deliverables including monthly progress reports, cost reports, risk registers, and schedule updates; provide timely executive briefings and exception reports
* QHSE, Closeout \& Team Management
* Champion a zero\-incident safety culture; direct the Risk Management framework; ensure ISO 45001, ISO 14001, and ISO 9001 standards are maintained across all Developer\-facing operations
* Lead the closeout phase through snagging, commissioning, handover documentation, and the Final Close\-Out Report; ensure all PMCM staff are mobilized within 30 days of written request


**Qualifications \& Requirements**
* Over 20 years of relevant professional experience; over 12 years in a Project Director or equivalent senior management role
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or a related field; Master's degree preferred
* Membership of a recognized Chartered or Professional Engineering Institution
* Demonstrated track record directing large\-scale land development, infrastructure, or urban development programs, ideally in the GCC/KSA context
* International / Western Qualifications and Experience

data.jd_text:

* Coordinate inputs from Design, Delivery, Procurement, Commercial, Finance, and Risk functions to ensure integrated and coherent reporting and decision support
* Assist in defining workforce plans, cost plans, and organisational structures for the Construction Management vertical
* Support recruitment of the Construction Management vertical by coordinating approvals, business cases, budgets, and onboarding requirements for new roles
* Maintain registers, trackers, and dashboards covering governance actions, budget approvals, headcount, and strategic initiatives

data.jd_text:
SYSTRA is one of the world's leading engineering and consultancy groups specialising in public transport and sustainable mobility. With over 10,300 employees, SYSTRA's mission is to design safe and sustainable transport solutions to bring people together, develop social inclusion and facilitate access to employment, education and leisure throughout the world.
   

  

 For 65 years, the Group has been working alongside cities and regions to contribute to their development by creating, improving and modernising their infrastructure and transport systems, throughout the life cycle of their projects. SYSTRA is involved from the earliest stages of design through to the testing, deployment and maintenance phases. The company provides all its services in over 80 countries worldwide and generates 74% of its turnover internationally. With its new services, SYSTRA supports its clients and partners in their digital, ecological and energy transition, in order to invent the mobility of tomorrow.
   

  

 Context
   

  

***This requirement is for a bid opportunity only at this stage. Any engagement will be subject to successful project award and final client approval.***
 The Project Delivery Manager will be responsible for leading the successful delivery of the railway program, with a strong focus on construction execution, package coordination, site performance, and overall delivery outcomes. The role requires a highly capable leader with deep expertise in managing large\-scale railway and infrastructure construction works, coordinating multidisciplinary teams, resolving interfaces, and ensuring delivery in line with schedule, budget, quality, and safety objectives.
   

  

 Missions/Main Duties
   

  

* Lead and manage the overall construction delivery of the railway program across multiple project packages, work fronts, or contractor interfaces.
* Drive site execution strategies to ensure safe, efficient, and timely delivery of all construction activities.
* Oversee and coordinate construction teams, subcontractors, package managers, and support functions to achieve program milestones.
* Ensure strong integration between engineering, procurement, construction, commercial, planning, contracts, and project controls functions.
* Monitor construction progress and productivity, and implement recovery plans where required to address delays or performance gaps.
* Manage site\-related risks, constructability issues, sequencing constraints, logistics challenges, and interface coordination across the program.
* Lead delivery reviews, construction progress meetings, and reporting processes to ensure transparency and timely decision\-making.
* Ensure construction activities are executed in compliance with project specifications, contractual requirements, quality standards, and HSE regulations.
* Support the development of construction methodologies, phasing plans, mobilization strategies, and execution plans during bid and post\-award stages.
* Act as a key point of contact for internal stakeholders, contractors, consultants, and the client on all matters related to delivery and construction performance.
* Promote a strong site culture focused on safety, quality, productivity, accountability, and delivery excellence.
* Support testing, commissioning readiness, and handover planning in coordination with relevant teams, where required.


 Profile/Skills
   

  

* The successful candidate will be a hands\-on, delivery\-focused leader with strong construction execution capability and a proven ability to manage complex railway works in live and challenging environments. They should be capable of driving site performance, managing contractors and interfaces, and ensuring coordinated delivery across multiple packages while maintaining the highest standards of safety, quality, and operational excellence.
* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline. A master’s degree is an advantage.
* Minimum 20 years of total experience in major infrastructure and construction projects.
* Strong experience in railway projects is essential.
* Proven project and construction delivery experience in leading major infrastructure, rail, or transportation projects from execution through completion.
* Strong background in construction management, site delivery, contractor coordination, and field execution.
* Prior experience in a Program Delivery Manager, Construction Delivery Manager, Senior Project Manager, or similar senior delivery role.
* Gulf experience preferred.
* Strong understanding of construction sequencing, site logistics, temporary works, constructability, project controls, and commercial impacts on delivery.
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex construction interfaces and multidisciplinary teams in large project environments.
* Excellent leadership, stakeholder management, communication, and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong knowledge of HSE, quality, risk, compliance, and construction best practices in major infrastructure projects.


 Systra is an equal opportunities company; this position is open to all applicants.

Our hybrid model combines a mix of in\-person (at client site or AlixPartners office) and remote working. Travel is part of this position, but the frequency may vary based on client, team, and individual circumstances.

 Are you ready to build a future that exceeds your expectations? At AlixPartners, a leading global consulting firm, we help CEOs, boards, and owners tackle their most complex, high\-value challenges—often those making front\-page news and shaping Board Room agendas.

 Buro Happold is supporting the transformation of cities and public services across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC, aligned with Vision 2030, national transformation programmes, and public‑sector reform agendas.  This role offers a rare opportunity to combine deep KSA market understanding, strong knowledge of the local NCP PPP lifecycle framework, and global best practice to help public authorities structure bankable, resilient, and outcome‑driven transactions that deliver long‑term value for citizens.

 As a Director, you will provide senior leadership to our Transaction Advisory and PPP offering within Municipal Services, driving growth, credibility, and excellence in delivery across KSA and the GCC.

* A Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Engineering, or a related discipline; a postgraduate qualification is highly desirable.
* Significant experience in Transaction Advisory, PPP, or Commercial Advisory, gained within a leading consultancy, advisory firm, or financial institution.

* Deep understanding of project delivery models, operating models, funding and financing structures, and risk allocation in public‑sector transactions.

* Strong leadership and people‑development skills, with experience building and leading senior advisory teams.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder‑management skills, with confidence operating at ministerial, executive, and board level.
* High analytical rigour, commercial judgement, and the ability to operate effectively in complex, multi‑stakeholder environments.

* Hybrid working arrangements
* Attractive salary and benefits package
* A strong commitment to your continuous development. Whatever stage in your career, we have a learning and development programme that will enable and empower you
* Entitlement to two memberships to professional bodies or subscriptions
* An international culture that wherever your career takes you at Buro Happold, you won’t be far from the exceptional.


**At Buro Happold, everyone else’s extraordinary is just our everyday.**
**Apply today and be a part of our legacy.**
**A place for everyone**
 Buro Happold values individual's flexible approaches to working patterns as an important part of the way you work and achieve balance. We welcome applications from those who are seeking flexibility in their careers.
   

  

 Our exceptional portfolio of projects is the result of the diversity of thought, identities, backgrounds and experiences that shape us. Appreciating each other’s differences is key, we want employees to feel they don’t have to mask elements of their identity to thrive.
   

  

 We are working to change the lack of representation of marginalised groups in the built environment and are particularly keen to hear from anyone who feels they are underrepresented in the industry. We have much to learn from one another. Embracing difference allows us to develop the most innovative and elegant solutions.
   

  

 Please let us know if there are any adjustments, we could make to the application process to make it easier and more comfortable for you. Contact recruitment@burohappold.com so we can work with you to support you throughout your application.

data.jd_text:
**About Lucidya**
 Lucidya is an AI\-native platform for customer experience (CX) intelligence that manages entire customer lifecycles autonomously, from initial engagement through retention and growth.
   

  

 Unlike platforms that only surface insights and leave the action to you, Lucidya completes the loop with proprietary NLU capabilities developed entirely in\-house and trained on millions of multilingual conversations, equipping marketing, support, CX, and research teams to deliver personalised experiences that drive measurable improvements in customer satisfaction, retention, and lifetime value.
   

  

**Why This Role Matters**
 At Lucidya, closing a deal is the beginning of the work \- not the end of it. Enterprise clients come with complex requirements, multiple stakeholders, and zero tolerance for delivery that doesn't match what was promised.
   

  

 This role sits at the centre of that delivery. You will be the operational backbone that keeps projects on track, stakeholders aligned, and risks visible before they become problems. You will work across Commercial, Product, Engineering, Finance, and Legal \- not as a coordinator, but as the person who holds the whole picture and makes sure every part of the business is moving in the same direction.
   

  

 If you are the kind of person who gets uncomfortable when things are vague, who builds structure because it actually helps, and who takes personal ownership of whether a project lands well \- this role is for you.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
**Own delivery from pre\-RFP to go\-live.**
* Lead pre\-RFP alignment sessions to validate scope, timeline, resource availability, and budget assumptions before any commitment is made
* Establish and enforce a handover framework from RFP to delivery \- with clear ownership and traceability at every stage of the project lifecycle
* Ensure every project proposal goes through cross\-functional validation (Commercial, Product, Engineering, HR, Legal, Finance) before it goes out the door
* Review vendor and subcontractor arrangements for procurement compliance and operational readiness


**Run governance like it matters \- because it does.**
* Design and maintain project governance frameworks that define accountability, escalation paths, and decision\-making checkpoints
* Keep a live project and risk register covering progress, dependencies, financial exposure, and compliance risks
* Maintain executive dashboards and PMO reports that give leadership real visibility \- not a sanitised summary
* Enforce stage gates and approval processes before any contractual, financial, or delivery commitment is made
* Run post\-implementation reviews that actually produce lessons, not just documentation


**Keep every part of the business aligned.**
* Serve as the central coordination point across Commercial, Product, Engineering, HR, Finance, Legal, and Delivery
* Lead project initiation, steering, and review meetings \- and make sure they produce decisions, not just updates
* Maintain consistent communication with internal and external stakeholders through dashboards, executive summaries, and progress reports that people actually read
* Facilitate procurement and vendor coordination, ensuring external partners meet internal standards and regulatory requirements


**Manage third\-party and vendor risk.**
* Oversee vendor and third\-party onboarding governance \- tools, processors, and contractors must meet data protection and regulatory standards before they touch a project
* Maintain a Third\-Party Risk Register tracking compliance obligations, privacy safeguards, and mitigation activities
* Coordinate with Legal, Compliance, and Data Privacy on risk assessments, incident responses, and breach reporting related to external partners


**Bring the same rigour to internal programmes.**
* Extend the PM framework beyond client projects to internal strategic initiatives \- process transformation, system rollouts, product programmes
* Track progress against annual strategic objectives and KPIs, and report it clearly to leadership
* Develop and maintain standardised PM tools, templates, and procedures that the wider team can actually use


 You are responsible for outcomes: projects that land on time, within budget, and without surprises.
   

  

**Who You Are**
* You have 5\+ years in project or programme management, preferably in SaaS or enterprise technology. You have managed complex, multi\-workstream projects and you know what good governance looks like in practice
* You are comfortable holding multiple complex projects simultaneously without dropping the thread on any of them
* You think in terms of risk before others see it. You flag early, escalate when you should, and never let a problem fester because it was uncomfortable to raise
* You have real financial acumen \- cost modelling, budget tracking, and ROI analysis are not tasks you hand off
* You can influence without authority. You work across functions where you do not control the resources, and you still get things done
* Your communication is clear, structured, and calibrated to the audience \- whether that is an engineer, a client, or a CEO
* You hold a PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent certification. You apply methodology pragmatically \- the framework serves the project, not the other way around
* You are comfortable in a fast\-scaling environment where not everything is defined. You build the structure and improve it as you go


**Culturally, you are:**
* Structured but not rigid
* Proactive, not reactive
* Calm when it gets complicated \- and it will get complicated
* Someone who takes ownership of outcomes, not just tasks


**What The Hiring Process Will Look Like**
* Screening call with Talent Acquisition
* Deep\-dive interview with the Head of Services
* Case study presentation \- project governance and risk scenario
* Offer

**Who We Are**
 NHU\-Riyadh is the Saudi branch campus of the University of New Haven, a private, nonprofit university founded in 1920 in Connecticut, USA. Launching in Fall 2026, NHU\-Riyadh will bring an American university experience to Riyadh through the same accreditation, faculty standards, and career\-focused educational approach that define the University of New Haven. The University’s academic programs are grounded in a long\-standing commitment to collaborative, interdisciplinary, project\-based learning.
   

  

 The University of New Haven is recognized by The Princeton Review and U.S. News \& World Report for academic excellence and is known for experiential, professionally oriented learning. NHU\-Riyadh is being established to deliver academically rigorous, industry\-aligned education that supports Saudi Arabia’s evolving workforce needs.
   

  

 Under the general supervision of the Director of Accounting, the Finance and Accounting Specialist will assist in the daily administration of the University’s Business Office operations at the University’s campus in Riyadh. Duties will include processing purchase requests, processing accounts Payable invoices, processing journal entries, assisting with WHT and VAT coordination for filing requirements, and other business function duties as assigned.
   

  

**You Will**
* Assist the Purchasing Department with identifying vendors to source goods and or services from within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
* Setting up vendors within the ZoHo 1 system upon approval by the Purchasing Director.
* Receive and process Purchase requisitions in support of the campus community.
* Process Purchase Orders from Requisitions once approved by the Purchasing Director and facilitate delivery of the Purchase Orders to the vendors.
* Receive and process Accounts Payable activity including invoices in support of the campus community.
* Code transactions to the appropriate general ledger accounts.
* Assist with coordinating the activity related to VAT (value added tax) administration and filing requirements.
* Assist with coordinating the activity related to WHT (withholding tax) administration and filing requirements.
* Organize, file and maintain financial documentation and records.
* Produce financial reports as needed / directed by management.
* Support internal and external audits.
* Use data insights to identify opportunities for improvement and inform decision makers.
* Work with administrative and academic staff to ensure financial controls are followed.


**You Need**
* Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance or business\-related degree required.
* Two (2\)\-years of relevant experience required.
* Good understanding of accounting/finance Office processes.
* Familiarity with Saudi VAT regulations and ZATCA requirements preferred.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Good command of English and Arabic.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Familiarity with the financial system, ZoHo1 is preferred


 Compensation, which includes salary and any potential allowances, will be established in accordance with Saudi Arabian compensation framework in conjunction with the successful candidate’s qualifications, experience, education and position.
   

  

 Any successful candidate for these roles will be processed, onboarded, and deployed to Riyadh through an outsourcing human resources company contracted by the University of New Haven specifically for this process. All academic duties will be supervised by New Haven University's administrative staff. Successful candidates will be required to obtain, and appropriately maintain, a Saudi Arabia Visa and related Work Authorizations through the contracted human resources outsourcing company.
