data.jd_text:
**Role Summary**
 The candidate should be a natural leader and have worked with reputable joinery manufacturing companies and the interiors industry (similar to Havelock One) for the last 8 years with experience in managing customs and retail installation projects.
   

  

 As a Project Manager, the person must be self\-driven with a high responsibility level; capable of effectively launching and managing multiple projects of different sizes from award of project and through the different stages of implementation to handover independently. Versatile and adaptive management of internal and external stakeholders is key. Communication skills are very important for the role, and the successful candidate will be a natural communicator and good articulator in both oral and written English.
   

  

 The profile will be a naturally dependable member of the leadership team that is able to bring about improvement and measurable positive changes in output and efficiency over time.
   

  

 The profile will be a team player, able to identify strengths and weaknesses in a situation and bring out the best of people in challenging situations.
   

  

**Role Description**
**Project Kick\-off** 
**:**
* Set up a kick\-off meeting with relevant internal Havelock One departments and the appointed fit\- out team. Where necessary, coordinate with the general contractor team to align project scope, timeline, and expectations


**Site Assessment**
* If needed to be able to conduct initial site visits, perform surveys, take photographs, identify loading zones, and provide feedback to the Setting Out Manager (SOM) regarding any crucial dimensions or site\-specific considerations


**Technical Expertise**
* Utilize hands\-on experience or expertise to carry out the setting out/marking of joinery equipment on\-site if needed
* Coordinate and address any technical queries posed by the client or general contractor team during the project kick\-o? and the Mw manufacturing cycle
* Coordinate and address any technical queries posed by the client or general contractor team during


 MW installation by thoroughly understanding the MW equipment throughout its lifecycle.
   

  

**Project Management**
* and the project's work schedule, preferably using MS Projects, to ensure timelines are met
* Generate daily/weekly site progress reports, including necessary photos, and submit them to the Project Manager (PM) and SOM for review
* Manage multiple projects at various stages of development, independently prioritizing and executing tasks to meet deadlines and achieve objectives
* Proactively manage ongoing projects, taking initiatives on tasks without requiring constant supervision or follow\-ups


**Communication And Coordination**
* Maintain effective communication and coordination with fit\-out teams, factory personnel, and clients/client representatives daily. Relay any discrepancies to the line manager for quick resolution
* Observe the installation process first\-hand and report to the setting out team any adjustments needed to the MW equipment to facilitate future fit\-out installations
* Demonstrate high self\-confidence and clear self\-expression during client interactions, negotiations with client demands appropriately and handling high\-pressure situations with composure
* Effectively coordinate with fit\-out teams, considering the full project scope when assigning tasks, and providing direct responses to on\-site queries and issues


**Travel And Flexibility**
* Willingness to travel to countries in the MENA region and beyond. Adapt to flexible working hours, including weekends, depending on travel and site plans as required


**Experience**
**Candidate Requirements**
* Minimum of five to eight years similar experience in a joinery manufacturing companies with experience in managing hospitality and entertainment projects


**Skills**
* Proficient in verbal and written English
* Ability to work with AutoCAD, Excel, Word, and MS Projects
* Strong customer service skills, ensuring client satisfaction and addressing concerns promptly


**Attributes**
* Sound knowledge of fabrication procedures and a wide understanding of joinery materials including timber, boards, veneers, laminates, hardware, fabrics, glass, stone, lighting etc are vital
* An individual with high responsibility levels who takes ownership of matters, has good planning \& time management capabilities, effective communicator and basically a flexible individual who can take decisions and make things happen in a large setup
* Excellent organizational and time\-management skills
* Strong problem\-solving abilities and attention to detail
* Ability to work independently as well as part of a team
* Strong interpersonal skills to effectively liaise with diverse stakeholders
* Self\-driven with a strong internal drive to achieve goals and tackle challenges head\-on without the need for external motivation
* Intrinsically motivated, consistently seeking out new opportunities for growth and improvement
* Excel at managing multiple tasks simultaneously, ensuring that each receives the attention and e?ort needed to succeed
* Ability to plan thoroughly, considering potential consequences and the bigger picture
* Capacity to follow clear instructions and ensure the correct implementation on\-site

data.jd_text:
**Senior Project Manager – Saudi Arabia/Al\-Khobar**
 We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly evolving world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make an outstanding addition to our vibrant international team.
   

  

 Siemens Digital Industries is a leading innovator in automation and digitalization. Our mission is to support customers in maximizing growth, profit opportunities and ecological footprint in the discrete and process industries. Ready to create your own journey?
   

  

 Join our Digital Industry as Senior Project Manager and help us transform the everyday by finding solutions and making the world a more inquisitive place for tomorrow.
   

  

**You‘ll make an impact by:**
* Managing customer projects end\-to\-end across the full project lifecycle, from handover through final acceptance, with responsibility for cost, schedule, quality, EHS and customer satisfaction.
* Actively steering project planning, execution, monitoring and control in line with PM@Siemens standards.
* Managing risks, opportunities, changes and claims, including identification of mitigations and commercial impacts.
* Coordinating cross\-functional and cross\-regional project teams, including engineering centers, partners and subcontractors.
* Supporting proposal, contract clarification and customer discussions by contributing project execution know\-how and solution understanding.


**Your success is grounded in**
* 10\+ years of experience in solution or automation project execution, with several years acting as fully accountable Project Manager for medium to large, cross\-organizational projects.
* Strong mastery of project management across the full lifecycle, including project planning, scheduling, cost control, forecasting, reporting, and governance according to PM@Siemens standards.
* Proven competence in risk and opportunity management, change management, claim management, and contract interpretation, including identification of commercial impacts and mitigation strategies.
* Solid understanding of industrial automation and process control solutions, including Distributed Control Systems (DCS), PLC and HMI\-based systems.
* Hands\-on project exposure to Siemens automation and digitalization products and systems such as SIMATIC PCS 7 (DCS), SIMATIC S7 (PLC), WinCC / HMI systems, and integration of industrial communication technologies.
* Familiarity with functional safety concepts and standards (e.g. IEC 61508\) as applied in automation projects.
* Strong commercial and financial project understanding, including cost controlling, cash flow, invoicing, forecasting, and collaboration with commercial project management and finance functions.
* Demonstrated ability to manage diverse stakeholders, including customers, internal engineering teams, global engineering centers, suppliers, and partners, without direct line management responsibility.
* Excellent communication, negotiation and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain technical solutions and Siemens capabilities clearly to customers.
* High level of intercultural competence and experience working in international, virtual, and cross\-regional project environments.
* Fluency in English for professional project communication; ability to operate confidently in customer meetings, reviews, and negotiations.


**Transform the everyday with us**
 We value your outstanding identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.
   

  

 We celebrate the fact that our people are individuals and have different preferences and needs. If we all thought the same, we would never think of anything new! That’s why we recruit extraordinary minds from all walks of life. We are committed to furthering our culture of diversity, equity and inclusion. We encourage applications from a diverse talent pool and are happy to give the opportunity to discuss flexibility and reasonable adjustment requirements. Many of our teams are working optimally in a remote, virtual adding to our ability to offer more flexibility on how you handle your time.
   

  

 Please note: Only complete applications can be considered in the selection process.

data.jd_text:
**IT Project Manager** 




  





 Join a growing IT Project Management function within a well\-established insurance organisation undergoing major digital transformation across customer experience, operations, integrations, and internal systems.
 



  





 This is a hands\-on Project Manager role focused on improving delivery, introducing structure, and helping drive critical initiatives across the business. The environment is fast\-moving, collaborative, and still evolving, so this role would suit someone who enjoys solving problems, coordinating people, and bringing clarity to complex projects.
 



  





**The Role:** 




 You’ll work closely with business users, technical teams, vendors, and senior stakeholders to manage projects from initiation through to delivery. Projects may range across applications, integrations, digital platforms, customer experience initiatives, infrastructure, data, and operational improvements.
 



  





 The IT Project Management function is still relatively new, so this is also an opportunity to contribute to how projects are managed across the organisation moving forward.
 



  





 This role suits someone pragmatic, organised, adaptable, and comfortable managing multiple concurrent projects at different stages of delivery.
 



  





**What You’ll Be Doing:** 




 • Managing end\-to\-end IT and digital projects across the organisation.
 



 • Defining scope, timelines, deliverables, dependencies, and resource requirements.
 



 • Coordinating cross\-functional teams across business and technical functions.
 



 • Working closely with stakeholders to gather requirements and keep projects aligned to business objectives.
 



 • Managing vendors, third\-party providers, and implementation partners.
 



 • Identifying risks, blockers, and delivery challenges early and helping drive resolutions.
 



 • Supporting and improving project governance, documentation, workflows, and delivery processes.
 



 • Tracking project progress through Jira, MS Project, or similar tools.
 



 • Preparing project updates and status reporting for leadership and stakeholders.
 



 • Helping introduce and mature project management best practices across the organisation.
 



  





**What You’ll Need to Succeed:** 




 • 3–5 years of experience managing IT, technology, or digital projects.
 



 • Experience coordinating multiple stakeholders across technical and non\-technical teams.
 



 • Strong communication and problem\-solving skills.
 



 • Good understanding of Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies.
 



 • Experience with project management tools such as Jira, MS Project, Confluence, or similar.
 



 • Comfortable working across both applications and infrastructure\-related projects.
 



 • Experience working with integrations, APIs, migrations, SaaS platforms, or digital transformation initiatives is beneficial.
 



 • Background within insurance, banking, telecoms, MSPs, or other regulated/service\-led environments would be advantageous.
 



 • PMP or similar certification is a plus.
 



 • Arabic fluency would be a ideal.
 



  





**What’s in It for You:** 




 • Opportunity to join a business actively investing in digital transformation
 



 • Exposure to a broad mix of business\-critical technology initiatives
 



 • A chance to help shape and improve delivery processes within a growing PMO function
 



 • High visibility across business and technology teams
 



 • A collaborative environment with strong leadership support for improving project delivery
 



  





**Next Steps:** 




 If you’re currently managing technology projects and want a role where you can have real influence on delivery, process improvement, and business outcomes, this could be a strong opportunity.
 



  





 Send your CV or get in touch in confidence to learn more.
 



  





*nineDots is Bahrain's specialist technology \& outsourcing recruitment agency advertising this role on behalf of our client.*

 Dammam, Saudi Arabia

* Experience in automation, engineering, and instrumentation fields.
* Strong communication, negotiation, presentation, documentation, and reporting skills.
* Ability to coach, train, and work effectively with project teams.

data.jd_text:
We are hiring a Senior Executive Director to lead private equity investments from Bahrain, with responsibility for sourcing, executing and managing deals across the GCC and select international markets. This role is central to the platform’s growth and will work closely with senior leadership and the broader alternatives franchise.
 



  





**What you’ll do** 




  




* Lead origination, thesis development and pipeline management across target sectors and geographies.
* Run end‑to‑end execution on transactions: financial modelling, valuation, due diligence, structuring and SPA negotiations.
* Prepare investment‑committee‑standard materials and present, defend and refine investment cases at committee.
* Take active post‑close ownership through board roles, performance monitoring, value creation oversight and exit execution.
* Support fundraising initiatives, LP co‑invest processes and coaching/development of junior investment professionals.



  





**What you bring** 




  




* 12–18 years’ experience, primarily in direct private equity investing, with formative training in investment banking (M\&A, leveraged finance) or transactions advisory.
* A strong deal sheet demonstrating independently sourced and led transactions, ideally including co‑invest and co‑sponsor deals.
* Deep GCC/MENA market knowledge and established relationships with regional advisors, banks and asset owners.
* Expert‑level financial modelling and LBO skills, with investment‑committee‑ready analytical and presentation standards.
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics or a related discipline; CFA and/or MBA from a top‑tier institution preferred.



  





**Why this platform** 




  




* Join a Bahrain‑headquartered financial group with a growing alternatives and private equity platform, investing across the MENA region and key international markets.
* Operate from a modern waterfront financial district designed to host leading investment firms and provide direct access to regional capital flows.

**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Directs, coaches, supports, supervises, and evaluates (with the Sous Chef) all direct reports.
* Must have excellent food knowledge and a full understanding of culinary terms.
* Must be able to read, understand, follow, and prepare company recipes by maintaining the quality and consistency in taste according to the instructions provided by the corporate office.
* Must be proficient in completing tasks, work efficiently and productively.
* Must be able to work in any section of a kitchen.
* Coordinate and supervise all team members assigned to their section, assign and delegate tasks accordingly.
* Undertake recipe reviews daily. Maintain recipe folders in immaculate condition.
* Responsible for follow\-through on any request within the area of responsibility received from the direct supervisor or manager on duty; this may include show plates, food samples and random food tastings.
* Control production levels and recommend ideas for improvements and better cost controlling.
* Prepare daily electronic food requisitions needed for his section production and countercheck deliveries for its accuracy; Report any discrepancies to his immediate supervisor.
* Must be able to oversee any main section (Sauce, Entremetier, Fish, Roast, Outlet CDP, Tournant and Cold Kitchen) and its entire food production.
* Maintain and ensure that Public Health are followed according to company standards and expectation (referring to US, Anvisa, Shipsan, Canadian, Australian etc.) and always followed within their section.
* Ensures that the HACCP program is carried out correctly.
* Maintains their assigned area in preparation for announced or unannounced United States Public Health type inspection either done by the Food \& Beverage Director or the actual inspectors.
* Reports for duty at assigned times, follows their supervisor’s instructions, and ensures that personal appearance, uniform, and personal hygiene are in accordance with the company’s rules and regulations.



  





**Qualifications and Skills**



* A minimum of 8 years in an upscale hotel, resort, cruise ship or convention banqueting service and at least 2 years as Chef de Partie (shipboard experience preferred).
* A culinary school degree is required.
* Very strong management skills in a multicultural and dynamic environment.
* Very strong communication, problem solving, decision making, and interpersonal skills.
* Superior customer service, teambuilding, and conflict resolution skills.
* Knowledge of the principles and processes for providing personalized services including needs assessment techniques, quality service standards, alternative delivery systems, and guest satisfaction evaluation techniques.
* Strong planning, coaching, organizing, staffing, controlling, and evaluating skills.
* Intermediate computer software skills required.
* Possess a good understanding of basic accounting principles such as numbering flow, “Debits/Credits”, adjusting entries, and corrections.
* Ability to write reports and business correspondence and to establish a good rapport with the ship’s Senior Officers and the corporate office.

**Be Part of a Legacy Bigger Than the Game** 




  





 At Al\-Qadsiah Club we’re creating more than teams—we’re crafting a legacy that goes beyond the game, making an impact both on and off the field. Driven by ambition, synergy, and innovation, we aim to inspire generations while shaping the future of Saudi sports.
 



  





 This is more than just a job—it’s an opportunity to be part of something larger than yourself. At Al\-Qadsiah, you’ll play a key role in shaping our legacy, contributing to the nation’s sports vision, and making history every step of the way.
 



  





**Overview:** 




  





 As the Academy Head of Medical Services at Al\-Qadsiah Club, you will lead the delivery of medical care across the Academy. You will ensure the highest standards of player health, wellbeing, and safeguarding, while providing expert medical guidance to players and staff. You will oversee medical operations, drive best practice, and align all medical provision with the club’s performance objectives.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**Leadership and Management** 




  





 Lead the delivery of all Academy medical services in collaboration with the Academy Technical Director and Head of Medical Services
 



 Develop and implement an Academy Medical Framework, ensuring player health, wellbeing, and safeguarding
 



 Oversee medical department operations, including clinic management, equipment, and supplies
 



 Design and supervise the work of all Academy medical staff, providing guidance and leadership
 



 Establish and refine medical processes, reporting structures, and communication systems
 



  





**Medical Assessments and Interventions** 




  





 Assess, diagnose, and manage musculoskeletal injuries and health\-related conditions affecting Academy players
 



 Interpret medical imaging including X\-rays, CT scans, and MRI to support clinical decisions
 



 Deliver medical screenings and ongoing health assessments for all Academy players
 



 Provide immediate medical care during training and matches
 



 Develop and implement injury prevention strategies and protocols
 



 Coordinate hospital referrals and ensure appropriate medical interventions
 



  





**Collaboration** 




  





 Work closely with Academy and club departments to maintain a safe and high\-performance environment
 



 Communicate effectively with players and their families on medical matters
 



 Act as a key liaison with external medical professionals and specialists
 



  





**Operational and Professional Standards** 




  





 Support Heads of Department on internal matters where required
 



 Ensure all medical staff meet CPD requirements and maintain professional standards
 



 Deliver additional responsibilities as required by senior leadership
 



  





  





**Qualifications** 




  





**Desirable:** 




 Master’s degree in Sports Science, Medicine, or a related field
 



 PhD in Sports Science, Medicine, or a related field
 



 Specialisation in areas such as rehabilitation, orthopaedics, sports science, physiotherapy, radiology, or biomechanics
 



  





  





**Skills, Knowledge and Experience** 
 :
 



  





**Essential** 
 :
 



 Extensive experience in a medical role within a professional sports environment, ideally football
 



 Strong background in diagnosing, treating, and preventing sports\-related injuries
 



 Experience leading and managing multidisciplinary medical teams
 



 Expertise in rehabilitation and return\-to\-play protocols
 



 Experience working with elite athletes and understanding the demands of professional football
 



 Proven ability to work collaboratively across departments
 



 Formal training and experience in diagnostic procedures, including ultrasound\-guided techniques
 



  





**Desirable** 
 :
 



 Experience working in Saudi Arabia or the Middle East
 



 Multilingual capability, including English, Spanish, or Arabic
 



  





  





**Why Join Al\-Qadsiah?** 




  





 Be Part of the Legacy: Join a club that’s redefining the future of Saudi sports, striving to lead the competition and set new standards of excellence.
 



  





 Experience the Culture: Thrive in an environment that values quality, accountability, diversity, synergy, innovation, and ambition, while embracing harmony—this is the Qadsiah Way.
 



  





 The Executives in Sport Group are retained on behalf of Al Qadsiah SC to make this appointment.
 



  





 All direct applications and CVs will be forwarded to The Executives in Sport Group.
 



  





 If this role is of interest, then please press the apply button and include a copy of your CV.

**Job Purpose:** 




 To drive the delivery of a risk\-based Technology Audit portfolio, providing strategic assurance and insights that strengthen IT governance, controls, and business performance. The role leads complex technology audit engagements standalone or integrated with business audits, develops high\-performing teams, fosters collaboration, and ensures the Internal Audit function adds measurable value to organizational objectives.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities:** 




  





**Technology Audit and Advisory Delivery** 




  




* Supports with the technology component of a risk\-based IA plan by coordinating and managing the delivery of the IT risk assessment and annual planning activities. This involves proposing audit engagements for inclusion in IA plans, including the scope, timing, and required resources.

data.jd_text:
**Objective:**
 RCSI Bahrain is seeking to appoint a dynamic and clinically focused Lecturer / Senior Lecturer in Clinical Microbiology to support the delivery of undergraduate and postgraduate medical education within the School of Medicine.
   

  

 Given the clinically integrated nature of the curriculum, the University is specifically seeking a medically qualified clinician with expertise in Infectious Diseases and/or Clinical (Medical) Microbiology. The successful candidate will play a key role in delivering clinically relevant microbiology teaching aligned to modern medical practice, patient safety, antimicrobial stewardship, infection prevention, and clinical decision\-making.
   

  

 The appointee will contribute to teaching, assessment, curriculum development, academic advising, and scholarly activity, while supporting the continued integration of microbiology across systems\-based and case\-based learning. The appointee will collaborate closely with the Department of Clinical Microbiology in RCSI Dublin, including participation in teaching and assessment meetings to ensure a coordinated and standardised approach to teaching and assessment across both campuses.
   

  

 Appointment may be made at Lecturer or Senior Lecturer level depending on qualifications, experience, academic profile, and leadership contribution.
   

  

**Reporting To:** 
 Head of Department of Medicine or Nominee
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
**Teaching:**
 • Deliver high\-quality teaching in microbiology, infectious diseases, infection prevention, and antimicrobial stewardship across undergraduate programmes.
   

 • Contribute to integrated and clinically contextualised teaching within systems\-based and case\-based curricula.
   

 • Facilitate small\-group teaching, tutorials, laboratory interpretation sessions, clinical correlation sessions, and team\-based learning activities.
   

 • Support the development and delivery of clinically relevant microbiology practical and simulation activities.
   

 • Contribute to online and blended learning initiatives using the University’s digital learning platforms.
   

 • Participate in student assessment activities including question writing, OSCEs, practical examinations, standard setting, and moderation processes.
   

 • Participate in teaching and assessment meeting with the Dept of Clinical Microbiology, RCSI, Dublin
   

 • Provide academic mentorship and pastoral support to students.
   

 • Work collaboratively with clinical and basic science colleagues to ensure relevance and consistency of teaching delivery.
   

 • Contribute to curriculum planning, vertical integration, sequencing, and alignment of microbiology and infectious diseases teaching across the undergraduate programme.
   

 • Work collaboratively across disciplines including medicine, pathology, pharmacology, immunology, paediatrics, and public health to support integrated curriculum delivery.
   

 • Support clinically relevant microbiology practical teaching, simulation activities aligned to clinical practice.
   

  

**Research and Scholarship**
 • Contribute to scholarly activity, educational innovation, research, and/or clinical academic initiatives relevant to microbiology or infectious diseases.
   

 • Support student research, audits, quality improvement initiatives, and scholarly dissemination.
   

 • Develop collaborative links with clinical partners and healthcare institutions within Bahrain and wider region.
   

  

**Student Mentoring:**
 • Provide pastoral care, mentorship, and support in developing research projects to students
   

 • Participate in the Personal Tutor Program to support student well\-being and academic development.
   

  

**General:**
 • Participate in School and University committees, working groups, and academic governance activities.
   

 • Support quality assurance, accreditation, and regulatory activities as required.
   

 • Contribute to outreach, student recruitment, and community engagement initiatives.
   

 • Undertake additional duties appropriate to the grade of appointment.
   

 • Attend administrative and academic meetings relevant to clinical teaching.
   

 • Provide regular feedback to the Head of Department on program content and curriculum development and assist in implementing improvements where appropriate
   

 • Ensure that all RCSI Bahrain policies and procedures are adhered to
   

 • Participate in faculty development and medical education training activities as required.
   

 • Familiarises oneself with the RCSI Bahrain Virtual Learning Environment (VLE)
   

  

  

 Requirements
   

  

**Personal Specifications:** 
  

  

 • Medical degree recognised for clinical practice.
   

 • Specialist qualification and/or board certification and/or FRCPath or equivalent in:
   

  

 o Infectious Diseases, and/or
   

 o Medical Microbiology, and/or
   

 o Clinical Microbiology.
   

  

 • Eligibility for professional registration/licensure in the Kingdom of Bahrain.
   

 • Experience delivering clinical microbiology / infectious diseases teaching.
   

 • Experience in assessment design, moderation, and standard setting.
   

 • Experience with case\-based or blended learning approaches.
   

 • Postgraduate qualification in medical education or ongoing faculty development activity is desirable.
   

 • Ability to deliver high\-quality teaching and educational activities within required timelines.
   

 • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
   

 • Ability to demonstrate initiative
   

 • Strong organisational and administrative skills

**Job Description**
 Reporting to Head Technical Training, the position of Electrical Instructor is involved in the preparation of curriculum, training manuals, and materials as well as the delivery of technical training to the designated employees and other company staff.
   

  

**Key Result Areas (All Roles)**
* Conduct training needs analysis (TNA) and develop appropriate training programs including but not limited to externally accredited Diploma \& Certificated courses.
* Assist in developing unit technology specific Lesson Plans and supplemental instructional materials to deliver required knowledge, skills and attitude among the trainees.
* Deliver competency based technical training relevant to electrical systems for all units, infrastructure, equipment, systems and subsystems in the BMP refinery to prepare Electricians for greenfield start up, current plant operations and future positions of the BMP.
* Administer and deliver consistent Unit specific assessment, instruction and validation to electrical trainees, including but not limited to Electrical needs for:
* Scheduled and preventative maintenance
* Shutdowns and turnarounds
* Reliability and condition monitoring
* Hazardous area training, classification and certification
* High voltage switching and associated equipment training
* Refresher Training
* Ascertain that all training solutions are developed to enhance employee competency to maintain electrical requirements for all process plants during normal, emergency, and shut down situations, safely and effectively.
* Maintain accurate and detailed records of trainee's performance / progress and provide on the job support and guidance during and after the training event to ensure effective transfer of learning to the job.
* Follow Bapco’s strategic plan to provide effective provision of training closely aligned to the Competency Framework and OE processes.
* Evaluate and continuously update training courses to meet competency framework requirements and ensure that training solutions are in line with industry best practice.
* Acts independently regarding developing, scheduling and delivery with all associated in\-house communication.
* Establish and develop independent contacts with external suppliers as required and in developing training interventions for concerned departments to decide the most appropriate refresher and up skilling training requirements.


**Knowledge, Skills, And Experience**
* Minimum bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or equivalent.
* Minimum of 7 years' work experience of which a minimum of 3 years preferably in developing, conducting, and administering training programs for Oil Refineries or large Process Industries.
* Certified Assessor / Internal Verifier for Competency Based Assessment is preferred.
* Should be trained as a technical instructor with the ability to deliver general plant and process engineering learning modules.
* Work experience in Oil \& Gas Industry, preferably petroleum refining.
* Must have broad experience and familiarity gained from a wide range of refinery process units. Such as: Electrical substations, HV motors, VSD, electrical generators, UPS and associated equipment.
* In\-depth knowledge of learning theories and instructional design models. Lesson and curriculum planning skills.
* Ability to write effective instructional text, audio and video scripts.
* A good understanding of learning management systems is beneficial.


**About Us**
 Bapco Energies operates a portfolio spanning the entire energy value chain in the Kingdom of Bahrain. The portfolio includes wholly\-owned subsidiaries and specialized operating companies. Together, these companies drive Bapco Energies' mission to power the next generation.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Bapco Refining (with a legacy of being referred to as “The Company” in Arabic \- Ash Shariqa locally) is a trusted and enterprising organisation, which has never stood still since its inception. The first to discover oil in the Arabian peninsula in 1932, it started exporting crude in 1934, and installed the region’s first crude oil refinery in 1936\.
   

  

 Since then the Company has helped shape the modern Kingdom of Bahrain, not simply through the generation of wealth, but through its committed development of the people of Bahrain. The Company is known as the incubator of much of the leadership talent in Bahrain developed over many decades. Bapco Refining touches all aspects of life in the Kingdom.
   

  

 With a rich history of more than 85 years, the adventure continues with new ambitions and initiatives in the downstream sector as well as oil and gas field development. The most recent is the Company’s multi\-billion dollar expansion project which will significantly increase the Refinery’s capacity and employ the latest refining technology to meet future customer demands, latest fuels specifications and environmental compliance.
   

  

 Bapco Refining is engaged in the oil industry including refining and distribution of petroleum products, sales and exports of crude oil and refined products.

 This is more than just a job—it’s an opportunity to be part of something larger than yourself. At Al\-Qadsiah, you’ll play a key role in shaping our legacy, contributing to the nation’s sports vision, and making history every step of the way.
 



  





  





**Overview:** 




  





 As the Individual and Unit Coach at Al\-Qadsiah Club, you will specialise in developing the technical abilities and individual behaviours of Academy players across multiple age groups. You will play a key role in delivering individual development programmes aligned with the club’s game model, supporting both player progression and overall team performance.
 



  





  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**Leadership and Management** 




  




* Collaborate with the Head of Individual Development to deliver the Academy’s Individual Development Model

* Deliver high\-quality individual and small group coaching sessions focused on technical development and behaviour
* Design and deliver position\-specific and unit\-based training aligned to the Qadsiah Game Model

* Provide targeted feedback during team training sessions to support individual player progression

* Lead the design and delivery of video analysis sessions for individual and small group development
* Maintain and develop a library of training sessions and best practice content using club platforms (IterPro, Hudl, SportsCode)

* Contribute to Individual Development Plans and player performance reviews

* Engage with coaching staff to ensure alignment between individual and team objectives

**Essential**

* Strong understanding of individual player development across different age groups
* Ability to deliver structured and targeted individual coaching sessions
* Experience working collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams
* Strong communication skills and ability to engage players effectively
* Proactive and structured approach to problem\-solving
* Comfortable working within a new cultural and professional environment
* Fluency in English



  





**Desirable:** 




  




* Experience using performance and analysis platforms such as IterPro, Hudl, and SportsCode
* Multilingual capability, including Arabic or Spanish
* Previous experience as a professional footballer Experience working in the Middle East

**Why Join Al\-Qadsiah?** 




  





 Be Part of the Legacy: Join a club that’s redefining the future of Saudi sports, striving to lead the competition and set new standards of excellence.

data.raw_snippet: We are seeking an exceptional Finance Director to serve as the principal financial confidant and strategic adviser within a dynamic entrepreneur's Private Office. This is a rare, standalone appointment offering unparalleled direct access and genuine influence at the very centre of a high\-profile in
data.jd_text:
We are seeking an exceptional Finance Director to serve as the principal financial confidant and strategic adviser within a dynamic entrepreneur's Private Office. This is a rare, standalone appointment offering unparalleled direct access and genuine influence at the very centre of a high\-profile individual's business and personal financial world.
 



  





**The Role** 




 Embedded within the Private Office and reporting exclusively to the principal, you will serve as the financial backbone of a fast\-moving entrepreneurial operation — spanning a diverse portfolio of business interests, personal wealth, and investment assets including property and tangibles. This is not a corporate finance role. You will operate with full independence from all existing business lines, acting as the principal's most trusted financial voice: candid, proactive, and wholly aligned to his interests.
 



  





 You will be an exceptionally competent accountant and expected to think and act like a true business partner — anticipating needs, identifying risks and opportunities, and bringing genuine commercial instinct to every interaction.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Act as the principal financial adviser across all private office matters, business interests, and personal wealth
* Own the consolidation and interpretation of financial data across a complex, multi\-entity portfolio — translating it into clear, actionable intelligence for the principal
* Provide proactive, commercially sharp advice on tax planning, cash management, and capital allocation
* Monitor performance across the portfolio, flagging issues and opportunities with candour and speed
* Oversee financial governance, reporting cadences, and controls appropriate to a private entrepreneurial structure
* Support deal evaluation, acquisitions, and new ventures as they arise — the principal moves quickly and expects his Finance Director to move with him
* Maintain absolute confidentiality and discretion across all matters at all times



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent) with substantial post\-qualification experience (min 10 years), ideally with exposure to private office, family office, or entrepreneurial environments
* A genuine entrepreneurial mindset — you thrive in ambiguity, move at pace, and are energised rather than unsettled by a principal who operates across multiple ventures simultaneously
* Proven experience providing financial counsel directly to a business owner, principal, or UHNW individual — not just reporting upwards within a large organisation
* Deep familiarity with complex, multi\-entity financial structures; comfortable across both corporate and personal financial matters
* Exceptional analytical capability combined with the judgement to know what matters and the confidence to say so plainly
* Outstanding interpersonal skills — this role demands a trusted relationship with a highly successful, highly demanding individual; you must be direct, reliable, and easy to work alongside
* Unimpeachable discretion; the handling of sensitive personal and commercial information is central to this role
* Self\-directing and highly organised — you will set your own agenda and be held accountable for outcomes, not activity

 The job holder is responsible for managing the processes, and strategic initiatives within the procurement function to ensure efficient, compliant, and cost\-effective sourcing. The job holder oversees project portfolios, supplier relationship management, performance reporting (KPIs).
   

  

 Key Accountabilities
   

  

* Enforcing procurement policies, standards, Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and methodologies across the organization to ensure compliance.

* Provide regular reporting on the procurement initiative status and progress

* Resume/CV
* Highest Education Qualification

**Objective** 




 The Head of Operational Excellence is responsible for establishing and embedding a sustainable culture of continuous improvement across the Group’s diverse business verticals including trading \& manufacturing, engineering, automotive, power solutions, financial services, office automation, car rental, and leasing etc. The role carries a Group\-wide mandate and is positioned to deliver measurable improvements in operational efficiency, quality, customer experience, financial performance, and overall Group competitiveness. The Head of Operational Excellence will collaborate closely with respective MDs and Divisional Heads to assess existing operational processes and implement best\-in\-class strategies and frameworks tailored to each division’s operational requirements and challenges.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Develop and execute the Group’s Operational Excellence strategy, roadmap, and governance framework.
* Lead the deployment of Lean, Six Sigma, and Kaizen methodologies across business units to drive efficiency, quality, sustainable cost optimization, and cross\-functional operational synergies.
* Partner with executive leadership and business heads to identify transformation priorities and translate them into measurable business outcomes.
* Build, develop, and mentor a high\-performing Operational Excellence team, supported by a network of internal change agents and certified practitioners.
* Define and monitor performance indicators, benchmark against industry best practice, and report progress, risks, and transformation outcomes to senior management through effective governance and performance reporting mechanisms.
* Lead change management, capability development, and the institutionalisation of best practices Group\-wide.



  





**Expected Outcomes** 



* Achieve measurable improvements in operational efficiency, process effectiveness and service quality across all Group’s business divisions.
* Implement sustainable cost optimization strategies through process improvement, resource optimization, and operational standardization.
* Increase customer satisfaction across service\-oriented divisions by improving response times, service quality, and overall customer experience.
* Ensure the successful execution of key strategic operational projects within approved scope, timelines, and budget, with no major delays or cost overruns.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, innovation, and operational excellence across all levels of the organization.



  





**Educational Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field is required, a Master’s degree or MBA is highly preferred.
* Lean Six Sigma Master Black Belt certification (or Black Belt supported by a demonstrable leadership track record)



  





**Experience** 



* Minimum of 12–15 years of progressive experience in Operational Excellence, Business Transformation, or Continuous Improvement, with a substantial portion in senior leadership roles.
* Proven track record of implementing large\-scale operational excellence programs within a multi\-industry environment (e.g., manufacturing, financial services, automotive, etc.)
* Prior experience in the GCC region will be considered a distinct advantage.



  





**Skills and Competencies** 



* Demonstrated success leading enterprise\-wide transformation initiatives, operational improvement programs, and cross\-functional strategic projects, ideally within a multi\-sector group or large conglomerate environment.
* Strong commercial acumen, executive presence, and proven ability to influence at Board and C\-suite level.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and change leadership capabilities.
* Fluency in English is essential; proficiency in Arabic is highly desirable.



  





**Benefits** 



* Attractive fixed and variable compensation
* Staff car
* Paid annual leave



  





**Job Remarks** 



* Preferred Language: English, Arabic
* Job Country: Kuwait
* Duty Shift / Timings: One Shift / 07:00 AM to 03:00 PM

SaaS Business Unit Manager
 



  





 Sales, Growth, Customer Success \& Operations
 



  





**About the Company** 




  





 We are an established technology company in Kuwait with several years of market experience, a growing base of more than 600 business customers, and strong relationships with leading local and international partners.
 



  





 The company operates in the business technology sector, providing software, SaaS, payment\-related solutions, hardware, and digital business tools for SMEs and enterprise clients. The SaaS business unit is already active in the market and is now entering a new growth stage that requires stronger structure, leadership, sales execution, customer success, and scalable operations.
 



  





 This is not a role to build something from zero. It is an opportunity to lead and scale an existing business line with real customers, proven demand, market credibility, and strong growth potential.
 



  





  





  





**Role Overview** 




  





 We are looking for a strong, hands\-on SaaS Business Unit Manager to lead the growth and daily operations of our SaaS product in Kuwait.
 



  





 This is a key leadership role for someone who can combine B2B sales, growth execution, customer onboarding, customer success, technical support operations, team building, and process management.
 



  





 The right candidate will take ownership of the SaaS business unit and help build it into a scalable, well\-organized, and high\-growth operation.
 



  





  





**Why Join Us** 




  





 This is not a narrow sales or operations role. It is an opportunity to lead and grow a complete SaaS business unit with direct impact on revenue, customer experience, team structure, and market expansion.
 



  





 You will work closely with senior management, have clear ownership, and play a central role in building the company’s SaaS growth engine in Kuwait.
 



  





  





 1\. Role Objective
 



  





 Lead the full commercial and operational performance of the SaaS business unit, including sales, growth, marketing coordination, onboarding, customer success, technical support, team management, and daily execution.
 



  





 The goal is to build a scalable SaaS operation with clear ownership, structure, and measurable performance, allowing senior management to focus on strategic partnerships, major deals, and product development.
 



  





  





  





 2\. Sales \& Revenue
 



  





 Own sales targets, pipeline management, lead follow\-up, demos, closing activities, renewals, and revenue growth.
 



  





 Build and manage a structured sales process, improve conversion rates, train the sales team, and ensure full CRM discipline.
 



  





  





 3\. Growth \& Marketing
 



  





 Coordinate with marketing to generate qualified leads through campaigns, offers, content, landing pages, WhatsApp messages, and sector\-specific promotions.
 



  





 Measure marketing impact based on lead quality, conversion rate, customer acquisition, and revenue generated.
 



  





  





 4\. Customer Onboarding
 



  





 Manage the full onboarding journey from contract signing to go\-live.
 



  





 Create clear onboarding checklists, assign responsibilities, reduce activation delays, and ensure customers start using the system properly.
 



  





  





  





 5\. Customer Success \& Retention
 



  





 Ensure customer satisfaction, product adoption, renewals, upselling, and churn reduction.
 



  





 Monitor customer issues and usage patterns, identify at\-risk customers early, and build proactive follow\-up processes.
 



  





  





  





 6\. Technical Support Operations
 



  





 Organize daily technical support operations, ticket handling, issue classification, escalation rules, response time, and resolution follow\-up.
 



  





 Coordinate between customers, support staff, technical teams, and management to ensure fast and professional support.
 



  





  





  





 7\. Team Management
 



  





 Plan, hire, train, and manage the required sales, onboarding, customer success, and support teams.
 



  





 Set KPIs, monitor performance, improve discipline, and build a culture of accountability, teamwork, and customer service quality.
 



  





  





  





 8\. Operations \& Processes
 



  





 Build and improve SOPs for sales, onboarding, support, reporting, internal coordination, and customer follow\-up.
 



  





 Reduce operational chaos, dependency on individuals, and create a scalable operating system for the SaaS business.
 



  





  





  





 9\. Product \& Market Feedback
 



  





 Collect feedback from customers, sales, onboarding, and support teams.
 



  





 Organize product improvement requests and coordinate with the development/product team based on business impact, customer value, and scalability.
 



  





  





  





 10\. Reporting \& KPIs
 



  





 Prepare weekly and monthly reports covering sales, MRR, pipeline, onboarding, support, churn, renewals, complaints, team productivity, and operational risks.
 



  





 Track key KPIs including leads, demos, closed deals, conversion rate, onboarding time, support tickets, response time, resolution time, customer satisfaction, and churn.
 



  





  





  





 11\. Authority \& Execution
 



  





 The manager has the authority to prepare business plans, growth plans, sales plans, operational plans, hiring needs, tools, systems, and required resources.
 



  





 Once approved by senior management, the manager has full authority and responsibility to execute the approved plan and manage daily operations within the approved scope.
 



  





  





  





 12\. Required Experience
 



  





 Strong experience in B2B sales, preferably in SaaS, software, POS, fintech, payments, or business technology.
 



  





 Minimum 5 years of experience in the Kuwaiti market is required, with strong understanding of SMEs, restaurants, retail, and local customer behavior.
 



  





  





  





 13\. Language Requirement
 



  





 Fluency in both Arabic and English is mandatory.
 



  





 The candidate must communicate professionally in both languages with customers, teams, partners, vendors, and senior management.
 



  





  





  





 14\. Required Skills
 



  





 Strong sales leadership, operational discipline, customer success mindset, problem\-solving, follow\-up, reporting, and team management skills.
 



  





 The ideal candidate is organized, data\-driven, commercially strong, customer\-focused, and able to build processes and teams from scratch.

data.jd_text:
**Building on our past. Ready for the future**
 Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts. We partner with customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their assets. We’re bridging two worlds, moving towards more sustainable energy sources, while helping to provide the energy, chemicals and resources needed now.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking an experienced Construction Project Manager to join our team in Ahmadi, Kuwait, supporting the Kuwait Environmental Remediation Program (KERP).
   

  

 You will play a pivotal role in delivering large\-scale environmental restoration initiatives. With millions of square meters of contaminated land successfully remediated, this project represents a globally significant effort in sustainable environmental recovery.
   

  

 This is an opportunity to contribute to transforming impacted land into safe, productive ecosystems while leading complex engineering and construction operations.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Project Leadership \& Delivery**
* Lead the overall management, coordination, and supervision of assigned remediation projects.
* Oversee budget development, cost control, and quality assurance to ensure successful project delivery.
* Manage engineering, procurement, and construction contractors on behalf of the Client.
* Ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and in compliance with contractual obligations.
* Develop and implement the soil remediation strategy for assigned areas, including contracting and execution approaches.


**Client \& Stakeholder Management**
* Act as the primary technical interface with the Client.
* Build and maintain strong client relationships, ensuring expectations are consistently met.
* Proactively resolve scope, schedule, and performance issues.


**HSE (Health, Safety \& Environment)**
* Champion a strong HSE culture across all project phases.
* Ensure OHSE requirements are embedded within design, procurement, and execution.


**Scope \& Contract Management**
* Ensure compliance with the Worley Project Management Plan (WPMP) and contract requirements.
* Implement robust change control processes.
* Support claims mitigation and management strategies.


**Cost \& Value Management**
* Monitor project costs and forecast outcomes, taking proactive measures to prevent overruns.
* Promote Value Improving Practices (VIPs) to optimize capital efficiency.


**Quality Assurance**
* Ensure adherence to Worley systems, policies, and procedures.
* Maintain strong oversight of engineering deliverables and quality standards.


**Team Leadership**
* Lead and motivate multi\-disciplinary and global teams.
* Drive achievement of milestones and key project objectives.


**What You'll Have**
* Education: Full\-time Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering from an accredited university
* Experience:
+ Minimum 15 years total experience
+ Minimum 5 years in oil \& gas / refinery / petrochemical industries
+ Minimum 5 years in a similar Project Engineering / Construction Management role

* Proven experience:
+ Managing multi\-disciplinary construction projects
+ Acting as deputy to a Projects Manager
+ Delivering complex environmental/remediation projects

* Demonstrated expertise in:
+ Soil remediation technologies and execution strategies
+ Engineering and construction management across full project lifecycle


**Preferred Experience**
* Experience in PMC (Project Management Consultancy) environments
* Middle East project experience (highly desirable)


**About You**
 You are a proactive and results\-driven leader with the ability to manage complex projects and diverse teams. You bring:
   

  

* Strong technical expertise and problem\-solving abilities
* Excellent stakeholder and client engagement skills
* A structured and strategic approach to project delivery
* Passion for sustainability and environmental restoration
* You will be recognized as a subject matter expert, capable of guiding teams, resolving complex challenges, and delivering high\-impact outcomes.


**Why Join Worley on KERP?**
* Work on one of the world’s largest environmental remediation programs
* Contribute to meaningful sustainability and environmental recovery initiatives
* Be part of a globally recognized engineering and project delivery organization
* Lead impactful, large\-scale projects with long\-term significance


**Moving forward together**
 We’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels they belong, can bring themselves, and are heard. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by law.
   

  

 We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation.
   

  

 And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology.
   

  

 Whatever your ambition, there’s a path for you here. And there’s no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

data.jd_text:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
 As a Commercial Project Manager at Siemens Energy, you will play a pivotal role in driving the success of complex projects, targeting candidates with a strong background in finance and project management. You will work on meaningful projects that shape the future of energy, ensuring commercial, financial, and contractual objectives are met, thereby contributing to Siemens Energy’s mission of delivering sustainable energy solutions. Your work will have a significant impact on the team, clients, and partners, fostering a collaborative culture that values innovation, integrity, and excellence.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Collaborate with the Project Manager to deliver projects within agreed commercial, financial, time, and quality targets, ensuring customer satisfaction throughout the project life cycle.
* Coordinate with customers, suppliers, and internal departments to facilitate effective project execution and maintain strong relationships.
* Manage and control project financial performance, including orders, revenue, costs, profit, cash flow, receivables, payables, inventory, and working capital, aligning with budget and forecast.
* Support monthly closing, budgeting, forecasting, controlling, and financial reporting activities to ensure accurate and timely financial insights.
* Drive optimization of project profitability, cash flow, and Net Capital Employed, maintaining a focus on financial health and sustainability.
* Ensure compliance with Siemens Energy policies, contractual terms, financial reporting guidelines, and local regulations, managing contracts, claims, and risk and opportunity topics.


**What You Bring**
* A university degree in Accounting, Finance, International Business, or related financial areas, providing a solid foundation for commercial project management.
* 3–5 years of experience in project controlling, commercial project management, or a comparable role, demonstrating a proven track record in managing complex projects.
* Strong knowledge of IFRS 15 and financial closing processes, ensuring adherence to international financial standards.
* Proficiency in SAP and Microsoft Office applications, enabling efficient management of project data and communication.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, fostering collaboration and effective stakeholder engagement.
* Ability to maintain audit\-ready documentation and support internal/external audits, ensuring transparency and accountability in project execution.


**About The Team**
 Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.
   

  

**Who is Siemens Energy?**
 At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With \~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
   

  

 Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150\-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
   

  

 Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens\-energy.com/employeevideo
   

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity**
 Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
   

  

**Rewards/Benefits**
* Opportunities to work with a global team
* Opportunities to work on and lead a variety of innovative projects
* Continual learning through the Learn@Siemens\-Energy platform


 https://jobs.siemens\-energy.com/jobs

BeCurious
   

  

 HR \& People; People Management
   

  

 Director of Operations
   

  

 The operational backbone of BeCurious — three branches, one standard
   

  

 Full\-time
   

  

* Kuwait City Reporting to: General Manager


**About Becurious Preschool**
 https://becurious.odoo.com/jobs/director\-of\-operations\-47
   

  

 BeCurious is a premium Finnish\-method preschool operating across three branches in Kuwait — Salam, Shuhada, and Salwa. Founded on the principle that curiosity is the most powerful force in early childhood learning, BeCurious has built a proprietary curriculum framework, a structured operating system, and a community of families who choose us for the quality of thinking behind everything we do.
   

  

 We are growing. We are building. And we are looking for the person who will run the engine.
   

  

**The Role**
* The Director of Operations is the operational backbone of BeCurious.
* This is not a coordination role. It is not a support role. The DOO is the person who makes sure that every session in every branch is delivered at the BeCurious standard — consistently, day after day, across all three locations.
* The DOO sits between the General Manager (who sets direction and owns the brand) and the Branch Supervisors (who run daily operations). Everything that matters operationally flows through this role.
* This role is right for you if you have a genuine love for early childhood education, a precise and organized mind, and the ability to hold a high standard without rigidity. You must be comfortable holding people accountable with warmth — not through fear, and not by doing their job for them.


**Responsibilities**
* Operations — Three Branches, One Standard:
* Own the daily operational standard across all three branches — Salam, Shuhada, and Salwa.
* Conduct monthly Branch Reviews with each Branch Supervisor (08\.1\) — reviewing KPIs, flagging patterns, agreeing action plans.
* Ensure every SOP in the BeCurious OS is being followed at branch level — and escalate deviations immediately.
* Manage the scheduling system — session allocation, teacher assignment, Home Preschool routing during continuity periods.
* Own the Feedback Log (08\.4\) — capture, categorize, and respond to all feedback across branches.
* Lead the Quarterly SOP Review (08\.2\) with the GM — identifying what is working, what needs updating, what needs a rebuild.
* Ensure branch readiness for Ministry inspections at all times — not just before announced visits.


**Team And Teaching Quality**
* Line manage Branch Supervisors — three direct reports. Support them. Challenge them. Hold them to the standard.
* Ensure all teaching staff are progressing through the Teacher Training Framework (02\.1\) at the required pace for their role.
* Conduct or coordinate classroom observations at minimum once per quarter per branch (03\.8 Classroom Observation Guide).
* Own the teacher evaluation process (04\.3\) — ensure evaluations are completed on schedule and that feedback leads to action
* Identify teaching staff who are ready to grow and flag them to the GM. Identify those who are struggling and build a support plan.
* Ensure no teacher leads a session alone without completing the required training stage for their role.


**Admissions And Enrollment**
* Own the admissions pipeline across all branches in Odoo — lead stages, conversion rates, follow\-up discipline.
* Oversee the Admissions Coordinator role — review their performance, support their work, escalate decisions that require GM involvement.
* Monitor enrollment capacity across branches — flag when a branch is approaching capacity or running below target.
* Ensure every family completing a tour receives a structured follow\-up within the required SOP timeframe.
* Review lead\-to\-tour and tour\-to\-enrollment conversion rates monthly — identify patterns and surface them to the GM.


**Curriculum And Learning Quality**
* Ensure monthly theme plans are submitted by Lead Teachers on schedule and reviewed before the month begins.
* Ensure weekly planning documents (03\.3\) are completed and filed — not treated as optional paperwork.
* Monitor child observation records (03\.7\) for consistency and quality — flag teachers who are not completing them.
* Ensure the Curiosity Lens Framework is visible in classroom practice — not just in documentation.
* Coordinate with the GM on curriculum development priorities for the year.


**Governance And Reporting**
* Attend the Weekly Leadership Meeting every Monday — present the Weekly Scorecard (09\.3\) and surface decisions that require GM input.
* Ensure the OS Change Log (00\) is updated whenever an SOP, template, or standard is modified.
* Manage incident documentation — ensure every incident has a completed 07\.5 Incident Report filed within 24 hours.
* Maintain the staff register in Odoo — civil IDs, health certificates, first aid certifications current for all staff at all times.
* Support the GM in preparing for the Annual Blueprint Review (08\.3\) — compiling the years evidence and identifying structural questions.


**What This Role Is Not**
* The DOO does not teach classes. This is a leadership and operational role.
* The DOO does not bypass Branch Supervisors to manage teachers directly — the chain of command is respected in both directions.
* The DOO does not make brand decisions — that is the GM's domain. The DOO executes brand standards. They do not change them.
* The DOO does not have financial signing authority above the limits in the authority matrix (04\.0\). Spending decisions above those limits go to the GM.
* The DOO's job is to make the standard work at scale. Not to be liked by everyone. Not to avoid difficult conversations. To make BeCurious excellent, consistently, across three branches.


**You Are The Right Person If**
**You will thrive in this role if you** 
 \|
 **This role is not right for you if you:**
* Have genuine experience in early childhood education or school operations — at least 4 years \| Are looking for a purely administrative or desk\-based role.
* Have managed a team before and understand that management means accountability, not friendship \| Expect to be liked by everyone you hold to a standard.
* Are organized to a degree that other people find remarkable — you track details without being reminded \| Find systematic documentation burdensome rather than protective.
* Can hold a high standard with warmth — you challenge people without humiliating them \| Prefer to avoid difficult conversations until they become crises.
* Are bilingual Arabic\-English — you operate at full professional quality in both languages \| Cannot communicate fluently and professionally in Arabic.
* Believe that curiosity in children is worth protecting — this is not a generic school for you \| See early childhood as a stepping stone to a different field.
* Understand that a system is what makes quality scalable — and you want to build that system \| Prefer to rely on improvisation and personal judgment over documented process.


**Required**
**Qualifications and Experience:**
* Minimum 4 years of experience in early childhood education, preschool management, or educational operations.
* Demonstrated experience managing a team — minimum 3 direct reports.
* Bilingual Arabic and English — professional fluency in both.
* Practical experience with a school management system (Odoo, Brightwheel, or equivalent).
* Based in Kuwait or able to relocate immediately — this is a full presence role across three branches.


**Strongly Preferred**
* Bachelor's degree in Early Childhood Education, Educational Leadership, or Business Administration.
* Experience with Finnish or play\-based education methodology.
* Experience leading or contributing to a curriculum quality review process.
* Experience with the Kuwait Ministry of Social Affairs licensing and inspection process.
* Demonstrated track record of improving operational consistency in a multi\-site environment.


**What BeCurious Offers**
**What You Get \| Detail:**
* A real leadership role \| Not a coordinator title with manager responsibilities. The DOO has genuine authority and is expected to use it.
* A built operating system \| BeCurious has a documented OS — SOPs, templates, review cycles, governance. You are inheriting a system and improving it. You are not building from nothing.
* Direct access to the founder \| Weekly leadership meeting with the Strategic Head and General Manager. Your voice shapes what BeCurious becomes.
* A curriculum you can believe in \| The Curiosity Lens Framework is a genuine educational philosophy. This is not a franchise curriculum or a generic play programme.
* Compensation \| Competitive, commensurate with experience. Discussed at the offer stage.
* Growth \| As BeCurious grows — more branches, Club, Camp — the DOO role grows with it. The person who builds the operational foundation at this stage has a significant role in the next one.


**How to Apply?**
 Send your CV and a short cover note (no more than one page) to the BeCurious HR Lead. In your cover note, answer one question: 'What does operational excellence look like in an early childhood setting, and how have you contributed to it?'
   

  

 We do not require a formal cover letter. We require a genuine answer to that question. Applications without a response to the question will not be reviewed.
   

  

 Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.
   

  

* First stage: written review of CV and cover note.
* Second stage: structured conversation with the General Manager.
* Third stage: structured conversation with the Strategic Head.
* Final stage: offer and reference check.


 We move fast for the right person.
   

  

**About Emerge General Contracting Company**
 BeCurious is a Finnish\-inspired, play\-based preschool in Kuwait where children learn by doing, imagining, and exploring. We create joyful, inclusive classrooms and partner closely with families to help every child feel seen and thrive. As a team member, you’ll design hands\-on learning experiences, nurture curiosity and character, and work within a warm, supportive culture that celebrates each child’s uniqueness. If you’re caring, creative, and collaborative, you’ll feel right at home with us.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
**Department: Center of Continuing Education**
**Reports to:** 
**Director \- CCE**
**Scope And Purpose**
 Center for Continuing Education (CCE) is committed to providing a wide range of professional development courses, training workshops, certificate programs, and customized corporate training solutions designed to meet the needs of individuals, businesses, and the community. By partnering with international certifying bodies and industry experts, the Center ensures that its programs are globally relevant, innovative, and aligned with labor market demands.
   

  

 The Training Operation Officer supports the effective delivery of CCE programs and training services by managing daily operational, logistical, and administrative processes. This role ensures that classes, instructors, and facilities are efficiently scheduled and prepared, that quality standards are consistently maintained, and that all post\-training documentation and reports are accurately completed. Working closely with the Team leader \- Training operation \& testing and the CCE Director, the training operations officer plays a key role in ensuring a seamless learning experience for participants and operational excellence across all CCE activities.
   

  

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
* Coordinate Training Operations: Plan and manage the scheduling and setup of CCE training programs, ensuring all logistical, technical, and material requirements are met.
* Administer CCE Systems, Data, and Operational Schedules: Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records within CCE’s management systems, including product sheets, class openings, participant and instructor data, and operational reports. Develop and monitor the annual training calendar, trainers’ schedules, and classroom allocations to ensure effective resource management, operational efficiency, and accurate reporting.
* Monitor Quality and Service Standards:Oversee training delivery and gather feedback from participants and instructors to uphold CCE’s quality benchmarks.
* Support Instructors and Participants:Communicate essential course information, coordinate instructor schedules, and provide responsive support to ensure a positive learning experience.
* Oversee Facilities and Logistics:Ensure training venues, equipment, and course materials are properly arranged and maintained to create an effective learning environment.
* Maintain Administrative Efficiency:Process course\-related forms, certificates, cancellations, and transfers promptly to ensure compliance and smooth program operations.
* Manage Testing Center Operations: Coordinate scheduling, setup, and supervision of CCE testing activities, ensuring proper administration of exams, adherence to testing protocols, and maintenance of a secure and professional testing environment.
* Process Trainer Payments and Financial Requisitions: Prepare and process trainer payment requests \& handle BC petty cash advances.


**Qualifications**
**Education:**
* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Education, Management Information Systems, or a related field is required.


**Experience**
* Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience in training administration, program coordination, or operation management, preferably within a university, continuing education, or professional training enviroment.
* Demonstrated experience managing trainign logistics, scheduling course setup, and reporting systems.
* Experience with testing center operations,including exam scheduling, supervision, and compliance with testing protocols, is highly desirable.


**Key Competencies**
* Administration: Effectively plans and coordinates tasks, resources, and schedules to ensure smooth execution of training and testing activities.
* Quality Management: Maintains high standards of accuracy and thoroughness in all operational and administrative processes.
* Applying Technology: Demonstrates proficiency in CCE systems, digital tools, and IT processes required for training delivery and reporting.
* Process Excellence: Understands, follows, and improves operational workflows to enhance efficiency and service quality.
* Information and Data Management: Collects, organizes, and analyzes data to generate accurate reports that support decision\-making and performance tracking.
* Office Management: Manages physical and digital resources—such as training rooms, materials, and equipment—to ensure readiness and proper utilization.
* Communication Skills: Communicates clearly, respectfully, and effectively with colleagues, trainers, and learners to foster collaboration and understanding.
* Service Orientation: Demonstrates commitment to providing high\-quality service to internal and external stakeholders through responsiveness and professionalism.
* Accountability: Takes ownership of responsibilities, delivers on commitments, and ensures consistent performance and dependability.
* Teamwork: Works cooperatively with others across departments to achieve shared goals and support organizational effectiveness.
* Adaptability: Responds positively to change, adjusting priorities and approaches to meet evolving operational and institutional needs.
* Self Management: Seeks opportunities to enhance personal effectiveness, update knowledge, and contribute to process improvement within the CCE.


**Certifications (preferred)**
* Project Management certification.
* Training Administration or Learning Management Systems (LMS)certification.
* Customer Service or Quality Management certification.
* Information Technology proficiency certification.
